  - chain: instant: target + jump to nearest unhit within 120, falloff 0.75; add lightning effect polyline.

  - multi: fire N projectiles at up to N distinct targets (or same).

chips.id=''; chips.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px';\n    status.forEach(m=>{\n      const mu = UNIT_BY_ID[m.id];\n      const c = document.createElement('div');\n      c.className = 'matChip ' + (m.have?'have':'miss');\n      c.innerHTML = `<img src=\"${portraitSVG(mu)}\" style=\"border-color:${GRADES[mu.grade].color}\">[${mu.grade}] ${mu.name}`;\n      chips.appendChild(c);\n    });\n    row.appendChild(chips);\n    const btn = document.createElement('button');\n    btn.textContent = ok ? (popOk?'▲ ASCEND':'⛨ POP FULL') : 'MATERIALS MISSING';\n    btn.disabled = !ok || !popOk;\n    btn.style.cssText='width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#a62e5b,var(--gEX));border:1px solid rgba(255,61,94,.5)';\n    btn.onclick = ()=>ascend(r.ri);\n    row.appendChild(btn);\n    rbox.appendChild(row);\n  });\n}\n\n/* ---------------- summon ---------------- */\nfunction rollGrade(){\n  if (S.pity >= CFG.pityEvery-1) return 'S';\n  let r = Math.random()*100;\n  for (const g of ['C','B','A','S']){ r -= GRADES[g].weight; if (r<0) return g; }\n  return 'C';\n}\nfunction summon(){\n  if (S.mode!=='play') return;\n  if (S.gold < CFG.summonCost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);\n  const idx = S.bench.indexOf(null);\n  if (idx===-1) return toast('Bench is full!', true);\n  S.gold -= CFG.summonCost; S.summons++;\n  const grade = rollGrade();\n  S.pity = grade==='S' ? 0 : S.pity+1;\n  const u = pick(UNITS.filter(x=>x.grade===grade));\n  S.bench[idx] = { uid:uidSeq++, id:u.id, cd:0 };\n  AudioFX.summon(grade);\n  log(`Summoned [${grade}] ${u.name}`, grade==='S'?'epic':grade==='A'?'gold':'');\n  if (grade==='S') toast(`✦ S-GRADE! ${u.name} answers the call!`);\n  bump($('stGold').parentElement);\n  renderBench(idx); syncStats();\n  if (S.sel) renderSelected();\n}\n\n/* ---------------- placement / sell / ascend ---------------- */\nfunction tryPlace(slotIdx){\n  if (!S.sel || S.sel.loc!=='bench') return false;\n  const u = S.bench[S.sel.idx];\n  if (!u || S.field[slotIdx]) return false;\n  const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id];\n  if (popUsed()+def.pop > CFG.popCap) { toast(`Population full! (${popUsed()}/${CFG.popCap})`, true); return false; }\n  S.field[slotIdx] = u; S.bench[S.sel.idx] = null;\n  AudioFX.place();\n  ringFx(SLOTS[slotIdx].x, SLOTS[slotIdx].y, GRADES[def.grade].color, 40);\n  log(`Deployed ${def.name}`, 'good');\n  select({loc:'field', idx:slotIdx});\n  syncStats();\n  return true;\n}\nfunction sellSelected(){\n  if (!S.sel) return;\n  const arr = S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;\n  const u = arr[S.sel.idx]; if (!u) return;\n  const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id], g = GRADES[def.grade];\n  S.gold += g.sell; S.goldEarned += g.sell;\n  arr[S.sel.idx] = null;\n  AudioFX.sell();\n  log(`Sold ${def.name} for ◈${g.sell}`, 'gold');\n  select(null); syncStats();\n}\nfunction ascend(ri){\n  const r = RECIPES[ri];\n  if (!S.sel) return;\n  const baseArr = S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;\n  const base = baseArr[S.sel.idx];\n  if (!base || base.id!==r.base) return;\n  const status = matStatus(r, S.sel);\n  if (!status.every(m=>m.have)) return toast('Materials missing!', true);\n  const res = UNIT_BY_ID[r.result];\n  const baseDef = UNIT_BY_ID[base.id];\n  if (S.sel.loc==='field' && popUsed()-baseDef.pop+res.pop > CFG.popCap)\n    return toast('Not enough population!', true);\n  status.forEach(m=>{\n    const arr = m.ref.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;\n    arr[m.ref.idx] = null;\n  });\n  base.id = r.result; base.cd = 0;\n  S.ascensions++;\n  AudioFX.ascend();\n  const pos = S.sel.loc==='field' ? SLOTS[S.sel.idx] : null;\n  if (pos){ ringFx(pos.x,pos.y,GRADES.EX.color,90); ringFx(pos.x,pos.y,'#ffd23d',60); burst(pos.x,pos.y,GRADES.EX.color,26); S.shake=Math.max(S.shake,6); }\n  banner('▲ ASCENSION ▲');\n  log(`▲ ASCENDED into ${res.name}!`, 'epic');\n  toast(`▲ ${res.name} awakens!`);\n  renderBench(); renderSelected(); syncStats();\n}\n\n/* ---------------- waves & enemies ---------------- */\nfunction buildWave(w){\n  const q = [];\n  const count = Math.min(28, 8 + w*2);\n  const isBoss = w%5===0;\n  for (let i=0;i<count;i++){\n    let type='normal';\n    const r=Math.random();\n    if (w>=7 && r<0.18) type='regen';\n    else if (w>=4 && r<0.38) type='armor';\n    else if (w>=2 && r<0.62) type='swift';\n    q.push(type);\n  }\n  if (isBoss) q.push('boss');\n  return q;\n}\nconst ETYPES = {\n  normal:{ hp:1,   sp:72,  r:9,  color:'#ff7a4d', gold:1,   leak:1 },\n  swift: { hp:0.6, sp:118, r:7,  color:'#3de0c8', gold:1,   leak:1 },\n  armor: { hp:1.5, sp:58,  r:10, color:'#9ab0c8', gold:1.4, leak:1, armor:0.3 },\n  regen: { hp:1.1, sp:66,  r:9,  color:'#5dc86a', gold:1.3, leak:1, regen:0.02 },\n  boss:  { hp:11,  sp:46,  r:17, color:'#e14dff', gold:12,  leak:5, boss:true },\n};\nfunction startWave(){\n  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.waveActive) return;\n  S.wave++;\n  S.waveActive = true;\n  S.spawnQueue = buildWave(S.wave);\n  S.spawnT = 0.4;\n  const boss = S.wave%5===0;\n  banner(boss ? `⚠ WAVE ${S.wave} — BOSS ⚠` : `WAVE ${S.wave}`);\n  boss ? AudioFX.boss() : AudioFX.wave();\n  log(`Wave ${S.wave} incoming${boss?' — a boss approaches!':''}`, boss?'bad':'');\n  syncStats();\n}\nfunction spawnEnemy(type){\n  const t = ETYPES[type], w = S.wave;\n  const hp = Math.round(24 * Math.pow(1.22, w-1) * t.hp * S.diff.hp * (type==='boss'&&w===CFG.finalWave?1.5:1));\n  S.enemies.push({\n    type, d:0, hp, maxHp:hp, sp:t.sp*rand(0.92,1.08), r:t.r, color:t.color,\n    gold:Math.round((3+w*0.8)*t.gold*S.diff.gold), leak:t.leak, boss:!!t.boss,\n    armor:t.armor||0, regen:t.regen||0, slowT:0, slowF:0, stunT:0, dots:[], dead:false,\n  });\n}\nfunction endWave(){\n  S.waveActive = false;\n  const interest = Math.min(50, Math.floor(S.gold*0.08));\n  const bonus = Math.round((35 + S.wave*6) * S.diff.gold) + interest;\n  S.gold += bonus; S.goldEarned += bonus;\n  log(`Wave ${S.wave} cleared! +◈${bonus}${interest?` (incl. ${interest} interest)`:''}`, 'gold');\n  bump($('stGold').parentElement);\n  if (S.wave >= CFG.finalWave) return gameOver(true);\n  if (S.auto) S.autoT = 2.5;\n  syncStats();\n}\nfunction gameOver(win){\n  S.mode = win?'won':'lost';\n  win ? if (opts.stun) e.stunT = Math.max(e.stunT, opts.stun);\n  if (opts.greed){ S.gold += opts.greed; S.goldEarned += opts.greed; }\n  const p = pathPos(e.d);\n  if (opts.crit || real >= 60) float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, Math.round(real), opts.crit?'#ffc93d':'#f2ead8', opts.crit?15:11);\n  if (e.hp <= 0){\n    e.dead = true;\n    S.kills++; S.gold += e.gold; S.goldEarned += e.gold;\n    burst(p.x, p.y, bump($('stGold').parentElement);\n    syncStats();\n  } else AudioFX.hit();\n}\nfunction enemiesInRange(x,y,r){\n  const out=[];\n  for (const e of S.enemies){\n    if (e.dead) continue;\n    const p=pathPos(e.d);\n    if ((p.x-x)**2+(p.y-y)**2 <= r*r) out.push({e,p});\n  }\n  return out;\n}\nfunction unitAttack(u, def, x, y){\n  const inR = enemiesInRange(x,y,def.range);\n  if (!inR.length)    }\n    case 'slow': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {slow:def.slow, slowT:def.slowT, aoe:def.aoe}); break;\n    case 'stun': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, stunC:def.stunC, stunT:def.stunT});      break;\n    }\n    case 'chain': {\n      let cur = first, prev={x,y}; const hit=new Set(); const pts=[{x,y}];\n      let dmg = def.dmg*mult;\n      for (let i=0;i<(def.chain||3);i++){\n  break;\n    }\n  }\n  return true;\n}\nfunction projectileImpact(pr){\n  const def = pr.def;\n  const hitOne = (e)=>{\n    damageEnemy(e, pr.dmg, {\n      crit:pr.crit, dot:pr.dot, dotT:pr.dotT, S.floats.push({x:x+rand(-6,6),y,txt:String(txt),color,size,t:0,life:0.8});\n  if (S.floats.length>60) S.floats.shift();\n}\n\n/* ---------------- update ---------------- */\nfunction update(dt){\n  S.time += dt;\n  // spawning\n  if (S.waveActive && S.spawnQueue.length){\n    S.spawnT -= dt;\n    if (S.spawnT <= 0){\n      const type = S.spawnQueue.shift();\n      spawnEnemy(type);\n AudioFX.boss() : AudioFX.wave();\n  log(`Wave ${S.wave} incoming${boss?' — a boss approaches!':''}`, boss?'bad':'');\n  syncStats();\n}\nfunction spawnEnemy(type){\n  const t = ETYPES[type], w = S.wave;\n  const hp = Math.round(22 * Math.pow(1.19, w-1) * t.hp * S.diff.hp * (type==='boss'&&w===CFG.finalWave?1.2:1));\n  S.enemies.push({\n    uid:uidSeq++, type, d:0, hp, maxHp:hp, sp:t.sp*rand(0.92,1.08), r:t.r, color:t.color,\n    gold:Math.round((3+w*0.8)*t.gold*S.diff.gold), leak:t.leak, boss:!!t.boss,\n    armor:t.armor||0, regen:t.regen||0, slowT:0, slowF:0, stunT:0, dots:[], dead:false,\n  });\n}\nfunction endWave(){\n  S.waveActive = false;\n  const interest = Math.min(50, Math.floor(S.gold*0.08));\n  const bonus = Math.round((35 + S.wave*6) * S.diff.gold) + interest;\n  S.gold += bonus; S.goldEarned += bonus;\n  log(`Wave ${S.wave} cleared! +◈${bonus}${interest?` (incl. ${interest} interest)`:''}`, 'gold');\n  bump($('stGold').parentElement);\n  if (S.wave >= CFG.finalWave) return gameOver(true);\n  if (S.auto) S.autoT = 2.5;\n  syncStats();\n}\nfunction gameOver(win){\n  S.mode = win?'won':'lost';\n  win ? if (opts.stun) e.stunT = Math.max(e.stunT, opts.stun);\n  if (opts.greed){ S.gold += opts.greed; S.goldEarned += opts.greed; }\n  const p = pathPos(e.d);\n  if (opts.crit || real >= 60) float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, Math.round(real), opts.crit?'#ffc93d':'#f2ead8', opts.crit?15:11);\n  if (e.hp <= 0){\n    e.dead = true;\n    S.kills++; S.gold += e.gold; S.goldEarned += e.gold;\n    burst(p.x, p.y,      break;\n    }\n    case 'chain': {\n      let cur = first; const hit=new Set(); const pts=[{x,y}];\n      let dmg = def.dmg*mult;\n      for (let i=0;i<(def.chain||3);i++){\n        if (!cur) .sort((a,b)=>((a.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(a.p.y-cur.p.y)**2)-((b.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(b.p.y-cur.p.y)**2))[0];\n        cur = next;\n      }\n      S.beams.push({pts, t:0, life:0.18, color:g.color, w:2.5, first.p.y, g.color, def.aoe);\n      }\n      S.beams.push({pts:[{x,y},{x:first.p.x,y:first.p.y}], t:0, life:0.16, color:g.color, w:def.aoe?5:3});\n      burst(first.p.x, first.p.y, g.color, 5);\n      break;\n    }\n  }\n  return true;\n}\nfunction projectileImpact(pr){\n  const hitOne = (e)=>{\n    damageEnemy(e, pr.dmg, {\n      crit:pr.crit, dot:pr.dot, dotT:pr.dotT, slow:pr.slow, 10	const AudioFX = {
11	  ctx:null, master:null, muted:false, lastShoot:0,
12	  ensure(){
13	    if (!this.ctx){
14	      const AC = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
15	      if (!AC) return false;
16	      this.ctx = new AC();
17	      this.master = this.ctx.createGain();
18	      this.master.gain.value = 0.42;
19	      this.master.connect(this.ctx.destination);
20	    }
21	    if (this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
22	    return true;
23	  },
24	  tone(f, dur, type='sine', vol=0.5, slide=0, delay=0){
25	    if (this.muted || !this.ensure()) return;
26	    const t0 = this.ctx.currentTime + delay;
27	    const o = this.ctx.createOscillator(), g = this.ctx.createGain();
28	    o.type = type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, t0);
29	    if (slide) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30,f+slide), t0+dur);
30	    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
31	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0+0.012);
32	    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0+dur);
33	    o.connect(g); g.connect(this.master);
34	    o.start(t0); o.stop(t0+dur+0.05);
35	  },
36	  noise(dur, vol=0.3, delay=0){
37	    if (this.muted || !this.ensure()) return;
38	    const t0=this.ctx.currentTime+delay, n=this.ctx.sampleRate*dur;
39	    const buf=this.ctx.createBuffer(1,n,this.ctx.sampleRate), d=buf.getChannelData(0);
40	    for(let i=0;i<n;i++) d[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*(1-i/n);
41	    const s=this.ctx.createBufferSource(), g=this.ctx.createGain(), f=this.ctx.createBiquadFilter();
42	    f.type='lowpass'; f.frequency.value=900;
43	    s.buffer=buf; g.gain.value=vol;
44	    s.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(this.master); s.start(t0);
45	  },
46	  click(){ this.tone(660,0.06,'triangle',0.25); },
47	  shoot(){ const now=performance.now(); if(now-this.lastShoot<70)return; this.lastShoot=now; this.tone(rand(820,980),0.05,'square',0.06,-300); },
48	  hit(){ this.tone(rand(200,260),0.05,'sawtooth',0.05,-80); },
49	  summon(g){

179	  const recs = recipesFor(ref.id);
180	  if (!recs.length){ rbox.style.display='none'; return; }
181	  rbox.style.display='block';
182	  rbox.innerHTML = '<div class="rt">▲ ASCENSION PATHS</div>';
183	  recs.forEach(r=>{
184	    const res = UNIT_BY_ID[r.result];
185	    const status = matStatus(r, S.sel);
186	    const ok = status.every(m=>m.have);
187	    const popOk = S.sel.loc!=='field' || popUsed()-u.pop+res.pop <= CFG.popCap;
188	    const row = document.createElement('div');
189	    row.style.cssText='margin-bottom:8px';
190	    row.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:${GRADES[res.grade].color};margin-bottom:5px">→ ${res.name} <span style="color:var(--ink-faint);font-weight:400">(⛨${res.pop})</span></div>`;
191	    const chips = document.createElement('div'); chips.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px';
192	    status.forEach(m=>{
193	      const mu = UNIT_BY_ID[m.id];
194	      const c = document.createElement('div');
195	      c.className = 'matChip ' + (m.have?'have':'miss');
196	      c.innerHTML = `<img src="${portraitSVG(mu)}" style="border-color:${GRADES[mu.grade].color}">[${mu.grade}] ${mu.name}`;
197	      chips.appendChild(c);
198	    });
199	    row.appendChild(chips);
200	    const btn = document.createElement('button');
201	    btn.textContent = ok ? (popOk?'▲ ASCEND':'⛨ POP FULL') : 'MATERIALS MISSING';
202	    btn.disabled = !ok || !popOk;
203	    btn.style.cssText='width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#a62e5b,var(--gEX));border:1px solid rgba(255,61,94,.5)';
204	    btn.onclick = ()=>ascend(r.ri);
205	    row.appendChild(btn);
206	    rbox.appendChild(row);
207	  });
208	}

210	/* ---------------- summon ---------------- */
211	function rollGrade(){
212	  if (S.pity >= CFG.pityEvery-1) return 'S';
213	  let r = Math.random()*100;
214	  for (const g of ['C','B','A','S']){ r -= GRADES[g].weight; if (r<0) return g; }
215	  return 'C';
216	}
217	function summon(){
218	  if (S.mode!=='play') return;
219	  if (S.gold < CFG.summonCost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);
220	  const idx = S.bench.indexOf(null);
221	  if (idx===-1) return toast('Bench is full!', true);
222	  S.gold -= CFG.summonCost; S.summons++;
223	  const grade = rollGrade();
224	  S.pity = grade==='S' ? 0 : S.pity+1;
225	  const u = pick(UNITS.filter(x=>x.grade===grade));
226	  S.bench[idx] = { uid:uidSeq++, id:u.id, cd:0 };
227	  AudioFX.summon(grade);
228	  log(`Summoned [${grade}] ${u.name}`, grade==='S'?'epic':grade==='A'?'gold':'');
229	  if (grade==='S') toast(`✦ S-GRADE! ${u.name} answers the call!`);
230	  bump($('stGold').parentElement);
231	  renderBench(idx); syncStats();
232	  if (S.sel) renderSelected();
233	}

235	/* ---------------- placement / sell / ascend ---------------- */
236	function tryPlace(slotIdx){
237	  if (!S.sel || S.sel.loc!=='bench') return false;
238	  const u = S.bench[S.sel.idx];
239	  if (!u || S.field[slotIdx]) return false;
240	  const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id];
241	  if (popUsed()+def.pop > CFG.popCap) { toast(`Population full! (${popUsed()}/${CFG.popCap})`, true); return false; }
242	  S.field[slotIdx] = u; S.bench[S.sel.idx] = null;
243	  AudioFX.place();
244	  ringFx(SLOTS[slotIdx].x, SLOTS[slotIdx].y, GRADES[def.grade].color, 40);
245	  log(`Deployed ${def.name}`, 'good');
246	  select({loc:'field', idx:slotIdx});
247	  syncStats();
248	  return true;
249	}
250	function sellSelected(){
251	  if (!S.sel) return;
252	  const arr = S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
253	  const u = arr[S.sel.idx]; if (!u) return;
254	  const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id], g = GRADES[def.grade];
255	  S.gold += g.sell; S.goldEarned += g.sell;
256	  arr[S.sel.idx] = null;
257	  AudioFX.sell();
258	  log(`Sold ${def.name} for ◈${g.sell}`, 'gold');
259	  select(null); syncStats();
260	}
261	function ascend(ri){
262	  const r = RECIPES[ri];
263	  if (!S.sel) return;
264	  const baseArr = S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
265	  const base = baseArr[S.sel.idx];
266	  if (!base || base.id!==r.base) return;
267	  const status = matStatus(r, S.sel);
268	  if (!status.every(m=>m.have)) return toast('Materials missing!', true);
269	  const res = UNIT_BY_ID[r.result];
270	  const baseDef = UNIT_BY_ID[base.id];
271	  if (S.sel.loc==='field' && popUsed()-baseDef.pop+res.pop > CFG.popCap)
272	    return toast('Not enough population!', true);
273	  status.forEach(m=>{
274	    const arr = m.ref.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
275	    arr[m.ref.idx] = null;
276	  });
277	  base.id = r.result; base.cd = 0;
278	  S.ascensions++;
279	  AudioFX.ascend();
280	  const pos = S.sel.loc==='field' ? SLOTS[S.sel.idx] : null;
281	  if (pos){ ringFx(pos.x,pos.y,GRADES.EX.color,90); ringFx(pos.x,pos.y,'#ffd23d',60); burst(pos.x,pos.y,GRADES.EX.color,26); S.shake=Math.max(S.shake,6); }
282	  banner('▲ ASCENSION ▲');
283	  log(`▲ ASCENDED into ${res.name}!`, 'epic');
284	  toast(`▲ ${res.name} awakens!`);
285	  renderBench(); renderSelected(); syncStats();
286	}

288	/* ---------------- waves & enemies ---------------- */
289	function buildWave(w){
290	  const q = [];
291	  const count = Math.min(22, 8 + w*2);
292	  const isBoss = w%5===0;
293	  for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
294	    let type='normal';
295	    const r=Math.random();
296	    if (w>=7 && r<0.18) type='regen';
297	    else if (w>=4 && r<0.38) type='armor';
298	    else if (w>=2 && r<0.62) type='swift';
299	    q.push(type);
300	  }
301	  if (isBoss) q.push('boss');
302	  return q;
303	}
304	const ETYPES = {
305	  normal:{ hp:1,   sp:72,  r:9,  color:'#ff7a4d', gold:1,   leak:1 },
306	  swift: { hp:0.6, sp:118, r:7,  color:'#3de0c8', gold:1,   leak:1 },
307	  armor: { hp:1.5, sp:58,  r:10, color:'#9ab0c8', gold:1.4, leak:1, armor:0.3 },
308	  regen: { hp:1.1, sp:66,  r:9,  color:'#5dc86a', gold:1.3, leak:1, regen:0.02 },
309	  boss:  { hp:9,  sp:46,  r:17, color:'#e14dff', gold:12,  leak:5, boss:true },
310	};
311	function startWave(){
312	  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.waveActive) return;
313	  S.wave++;
314	  S.waveActive = true;
315	  S.spawnQueue = buildWave(S.wave);
316	  S.spawnT = 0.4;
317	  const boss = S.wave%5===0;
318	  banner(boss ? `⚠ WAVE ${S.wave} — BOSS ⚠` : `WAVE ${S.wave}`);
319	  boss ? AudioFX.boss() : AudioFX.wave();
320	  log(`Wave ${S.wave} incoming${boss?' — a boss approaches!':''}`, boss?'bad':'');
321	  syncStats();
322	}
323	function spawnEnemy(type){
324	  const t = ETYPES[type], w = S.wave;
325	  const hp = Math.round(22 * Math.pow(1.19, w-1) * t.hp * S.diff.hp * (type==='boss'&&w===CFG.finalWave?1.2:1));
326	  S.enemies.push({
327	    uid:uidSeq++, type, d:0, hp, maxHp:hp, sp:t.sp*rand(0.92,1.08), r:t.r, color:t.color,
328	    gold:Math.round((3+w*0.8)*t.gold*S.diff.gold), leak:t.leak, boss:!!t.boss,
329	    armor:t.armor||0, regen:t.regen||0, slowT:0, slowF:0, stunT:0, dots:[], dead:false,
330	  });
331	}
332	function endWave(){
333	  S.waveActive = false;
334	  const interest = Math.min(50, Math.floor(S.gold*0.08));
335	  const bonus = Math.round((35 + S.wave*6) * S.diff.gold) + interest;
336	  S.gold += bonus; S.goldEarned += bonus;
337	  log(`Wave ${S.wave} cleared! +◈${bonus}${interest?` (incl. ${interest} interest)`:''}`, 'gold');
338	  bump($('stGold').parentElement);
339	  if (S.wave >= CFG.finalWave) return gameOver(true);
340	  if (S.auto) S.autoT = 2.5;
341	  syncStats();
342	}
343	function gameOver(win){
344	  S.mode = win?'won':'lost';
345	  win ? AudioFX.win() : AudioFX.lose();
346	  const mins = Math.floor((S.time)/60), secs = Math.floor(S.time%60);
347	  $('endTitle').textContent = win ? '✦ GRAIL SECURED ✦' : 'THE MOON CELL FALLS';
348	  $('endTitle').className = win?'win':'lose';
349	  $('endSub').textContent = win
350	    ? `All ${CFG.finalWave} waves repelled on ${S.diff.name}. The simulation is yours.`
351	    : `Overrun on wave ${S.wave} (${S.diff.name}). The grail slips away…`;
352	  $('endStats').innerHTML = [
353	    [S.wave, 'WAVES'], [S.kills, 'KILLS'], [S.summons, 'SUMMONS'],
354	    [S.ascensions, 'ASCENSIONS'], [Math.floor(S.goldEarned), 'GOLD EARNED'], [`${mins}:${String(secs).padStart(2,'0')}`, 'TIME'],
355	  ].map(([v,l])=>`<div><b>${v}</b><span>${l}</span></div>`).join('');
356	  $('endOverlay').classList.add('show');
357	}

359	/* ---------------- combat ---------------- */
360	function dmgMult(){ return 1 + 0.12 * S.field.filter(u=>u&&u.id==='mira').length; }
361	function damageEnemy(e, dmg, opts={}){
362	  if (e.dead) return;
363	  const real = dmg * (1 - e.armor);
364	  e.hp -= real;
365	  if (opts.dot) e.dots.push({ dps:opts.dot, t:opts.dotT||2 });
366	  if (opts.slow){ e.slowT = Math.max(e.slowT, opts.slowT||1.2); e.slowF = Math.max(e.slowF, opts.slow); }
367	  if (opts.stun) e.stunT = Math.max(e.stunT, opts.stun);
368	  if (opts.greed){ S.gold += opts.greed; S.goldEarned += opts.greed; }
369	  const p = pathPos(e.d);
370	  if (opts.crit || real >= 60) float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, Math.round(real), opts.crit?'#ffc93d':'#f2ead8', opts.crit?15:11);
371	  if (e.hp <= 0){
372	    e.dead = true;
373	    S.kills++; S.gold += e.gold; S.goldEarned += e.gold;
374	    burst(p.x, p.y, e.color, e.boss?30:8);
375	    if (e.boss){ S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, 9); ringFx(p.x,p.y,e.color,80); log(`Boss destroyed! +◈${e.gold}`, 'good'); }
376	    AudioFX.kill();
377	    bump($('stGold').parentElement);
378	    syncStats();
379	  } else AudioFX.hit();
380	}
381	function enemiesInRange(x,y,r){
382	  const out=[];
383	  for (const e of S.enemies){
384	    if (e.dead) continue;
385	    const p=pathPos(e.d);
386	    if ((p.x-x)**2+(p.y-y)**2 <= r*r) out.push({e,p});
387	  }
388	  return out;
389	}
390	function unitAttack(u, def, x, y){
391	  const inR = enemiesInRange(x,y,def.range);
392	  if (!inR.length) return false;
393	  inR.sort((a,b)=>b.e.d-a.e.d);
394	  const first = inR[0];
395	  const mult = dmgMult();
396	  const g = GRADES[def.grade];
397	  AudioFX.shoot();
398	  const fire = (target, dmg, extra={}) => {
399	    S.projectiles.push({ x, y, t:target.e, tx:target.p.x, ty:target.p.y, sp:460, dmg, color:g.color, def, ...extra });
400	  };
401	  switch (def.kind){
402	    case 'single': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {greed:def.greed}); break;
403	    case 'crit': {
404	      const crit = Math.random() < (def.critC||0.25);
405	      fire(first, def.dmg*mult*(crit?(def.critX||2):1), {crit, greed:def.greed});
406	      break;
407	    }
408	    case 'slow': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {slow:def.slow, slowT:def.slowT, aoe:def.aoe}); break;
409	    case 'stun': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, stunC:def.stunC, stunT:def.stunT}); break;
410	    case 'aoe': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe||40}); break;
411	    case 'burn': case 'poison': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe||40, dot:def.dot, dotT:def.dotT}); break;
412	    case 'pierce': {
413	      const targets = [first, ...inR.slice(1).filter(o=>(o.p.x-first.p.x)**2+(o.p.y-first.p.y)**2<95*95).slice(0,(def.pierce||2)-1)];
414	      targets.forEach(t=>fire(t, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, fast:true}));
415	      break;
416	    }
417	    case 'multi': {
418	      const n = def.multi||2;
419	      for (let i=0;i<n;i++) fire(inR[i%inR.length], def.dmg*mult, {dot:def.dot, dotT:def.dotT});
420	      break;
421	    }
422	    case 'chain': {
423	      let cur = first; const hit=new Set(); const pts=[{x,y}];
424	      let dmg = def.dmg*mult;
425	      for (let i=0;i<(def.chain||3);i++){
426	        if (!cur) break;
427	        hit.add(cur.e);
428	        pts.push({x:cur.p.x,y:cur.p.y});
429	        damageEnemy(cur.e, dmg, {});
430	        dmg *= 0.75;
431	        const next = S.enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead&&!hit.has(e)).map(e=>({e,p:pathPos(e.d)}))
432	          .filter(o=>(o.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(o.p.y-cur.p.y)**2<130*130)
433	          .sort((a,b)=>((a.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(a.p.y-cur.p.y)**2)-((b.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(b.p.y-cur.p.y)**2))[0];
434	        cur = next;
435	      }
436	      S.beams.push({pts, t:0, life:0.18, color:g.color, w:2.5, lightning:true});
437	      break;
438	    }
439	    case 'beam': {
440	      damageEnemy(first.e, def.dmg*mult, {});
441	      if (def.aoe){
442	        S.enemies.forEach(e=>{
443	          if (e.dead || e===first.e) return;
444	          const p=pathPos(e.d);
445	          if ((p.x-first.p.x)**2+(p.y-first.p.y)**2 < def.aoe*def.aoe) damageEnemy(e, def.dmg*mult*0.7, {});
446	        });
447	        ringFx(first.p.x, first.p.y, g.color, def.aoe);
448	      }
449	      S.beams.push({pts:[{x,y},{x:first.p.x,y:first.p.y}], t:0, life:0.16, color:g.color, w:def.aoe?5:3});
450	      burst(first.p.x, first.p.y, g.color, 5);
451	      break;
452	    }
453	  }
454	  return true;
455	}
456	function projectileImpact(pr){
457	  const hitOne = (e)=>{
458	    damageEnemy(e, pr.dmg, {
459	      crit:pr.crit, dot:pr.dot, dotT:pr.dotT, slow:pr.slow, slowT:pr.slowT,
460	      stun:(pr.stunC && Math.random()<pr.stunC)?pr.stunT:0, greed:pr.greed,
461	    });
462	  };
463	  if (pr.aoe){
464	    S.enemies.forEach(e=>{
465	      if (e.dead) return;
466	      const p=pathPos(e.d);
467	      if ((p.x-pr.tx)**2+(p.y-pr.ty)**2 <= pr.aoe*pr.aoe) hitOne(e);
468	    });
469	    ringFx(pr.tx, pr.ty, pr.color, pr.aoe);
470	  } else if (pr.t && !pr.t.dead) hitOne(pr.t);
471	  burst(pr.tx, pr.ty, pr.color, 3);
472	}
473	
474	/* ---------------- effects (data only; rendered in 3D) ---------------- */
475	function burst(x,y,color,n){
476	  for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
477	    const a=rand(0,Math.PI*2), sp=rand(30,150);
478	    S.particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,t:0,life:rand(0.3,0.7),color,r:rand(1.5,3.5)});
479	  }
480	  if (S.particles.length>400) S.particles.splice(0, S.particles.length-400);
481	}
482	function ringFx(x,y,color,r){ S.rings.push({x,y,color,r,t:0,life:0.4}); }
483	function float(x,y,txt,color,size){
484	  S.floats.push({x:x+rand(-6,6),y,txt:String(txt),color,size,t:0,life:0.8});
485	  if (S.floats.length>60) S.floats.shift();
486	}
487	
488	/* ---------------- update (driven by the 3D loop) ---------------- */
489	function update(dt){
490	  S.time += dt;
491	  if (S.waveActive && S.spawnQueue.length){
492	    S.spawnT -= dt;
493	    if (S.spawnT <= 0){
494	      const type = S.spawnQueue.shift();
495	      spawnEnemy(type);
496	      S.spawnT = type==='boss' ? 1.6 : Math.max(0.35, 0.95 - S.wave*0.02);
497	    }
498	  }
499	  if (S.auto && !S.waveActive && S.mode==='play' && S.wave>0 && S.wave<CFG.finalWave){
500	    S.autoT -= dt;
501	    if (S.autoT<=0) startWave();
502	  }
503	  for (const e of S.enemies){
504	    if (e.dead) continue;
505	    if (e.slowT>0) e.slowT-=dt;
506	    if (e.stunT>0) e.stunT-=dt;
507	    for (const d of e.dots){ d.t-=dt; if (d.t>0){ e.hp -= d.dps*dt*(1-e.armor); } }
508	    e.dots = e.dots.filter(d=>d.t>0);
509	    if (e.regen) e.hp = Math.min(e.maxHp, e.hp + e.maxHp*e.regen*dt);
510	    if (e.hp<=0){
511	      e.dead=true; S.kills++; S.gold+=e.gold; S.goldEarned+=e.gold;
512	      const p=pathPos(e.d); burst(p.x,p.y,'#5dc86a',6); AudioFX.kill(); syncStats();
513	      continue;
514	    }
515	    const slow = e.slowT>0 ? 1-e.slowF : 1;
516	    e.d += e.sp * slow * (e.stunT>0?0:1) * dt;
517	    if (e.d >= PATH_LEN){
518	      e.dead = true;
519	      S.lives -= e.leak;
520	      S.leakFlash = 0.5; S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, e.boss?10:5);
521	      AudioFX.leak();
522	      log(`${e.boss?'BOSS':'Enemy'} leaked! −${e.leak} ♥`, 'bad');
523	      bump($('stLives').parentElement);
524	      syncStats();
525	      if (S.lives<=0){ S.lives=0; syncStats(); return gameOver(false); }
526	    }
527	  }
528	  S.enemies = S.enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead);
529	  if (S.waveActive && !S.spawnQueue.length && !S.enemies.length) endWave();
530	  S.field.forEach((u,i)=>{
531	    if (!u) return;
532	    u.cd -= dt;
533	    if (u.cd<=0){
534	      const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id], s = SLOTS[i];
535	      if (unitAttack(u, def, s.x, s.y)) u.cd = 1/def.rate;
536	      else u.cd = 0.08;
537	    }
538	  });
539	  for (const pr of S.projectiles){
540	    if (pr.t && !pr.t.dead){ const p=pathPos(pr.t.d); pr.tx=p.x; pr.ty=p.y; }
541	    const dx=pr.tx-pr.x, dy=pr.ty-pr.y, dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
542	    const step=(pr.fast?640:pr.sp)*dt;
543	    if (dist<=step+4){ pr.done=true; projectileImpact(pr); }
544	    else { pr.x+=dx/dist*step; pr.y+=dy/dist*step; }
545	  }
546	  S.projectiles = S.projectiles.filter(p=>!p.done);
547	  for (const b of S.beams) b.t+=dt;
548	  S.beams = S.beams.filter(b=>b.t<b.life);
549	  for (const r of S.rings) r.t+=dt;
550	  S.rings = S.rings.filter(r=>r.t<r.life);
551	  for (const p of S.particles){ p.t+=dt; p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.vx*=0.96; p.vy*=0.96; }
552	  S.particles = S.particles.filter(p=>p.t<p.life);
553	  for (const f of S.floats){ f.t+=dt; f.y-=28*dt; }
554	  S.floats = S.floats.filter(f=>f.t<f.life);
555	  S.shake = Math.max(0, S.shake - dt*22);
556	  S.leakFlash = Math.max(0, S.leakFlash - dt);
557	}

559	/* ---------------- codex ---------------- */
560	function gradeLine(id){ const u=UNIT_BY_ID[id]; return `[${u.grade}] ${u.name}`; }
561	function buildCodex(tab){
562	  const body=$('codexBody'); body.innerHTML='';
563	  $('tabRecipes').classList.toggle('sel',tab==='recipes');
564	  $('tabArchive').classList.toggle('sel',tab==='archive');
565	  if (tab==='recipes'){
566	    RECIPES.forEach((r,i)=>{

114	function pathPos(d){
115	  d=Math.max(0,Math.min(PATH_LEN,d));
116	  for (const s of PATH_SEG){
117	    if (d<=s.start+s.len){
118	      const t=(d-s.start)/s.len;
119	      return {x:s.x1+(s.x2-s.x1)*t, y:s.y1+(s.y2-s.y1)*t};
120	    }
121	  }
122	  const s=PATH_SEG[PATH_SEG.length-1];
123	  return {x:s.x2,y:s.y2};

109	        """Read the header of a MPQ archive."""

The key MPQ decryption details:
- File key = hash of the basename (filename without path) using HASH_TABLE type ('TABLE' = 3)
- If MPQ_FILE_FIX_KEY flag is set, adjust: key = (key + block_offset) ^ file_size
- For sector-based files: the sector offset table is encrypted with key (not adjusted), and each sector is encrypted with key + sector_index
- For single unit files: encrypted with key

def decompress(data):
    compression_type = ord(data[0:1])
    if compression_type == 0:
        return data
    elif compression_type == 2:
        return zlib.decompress(data[1:], 15)
    elif compression_type == 16:
        return bz2.decompress(data[1:])
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("Unsupported compression type.")

        function s__playtime__get_hmsms takes nothing returns string
            local real record= TimerGetElapsed(s__playtime_PT)
            local integer rec= R2I(record)
            local integer h= rec / 3600
            local integer m= ModuloInteger(rec / 60, 60)
            local integer s= ModuloInteger(rec, 60)
            local string ms= R2S(record - rec)
            return SubString(I2S(100 + h), 1, 3) + ":" + SubString(I2S(100 + m), 1, 3) + ":" + SubString(I2S(100 + s), 1, 3) + SubString(ms, 1, StringLength(ms))
        endfunction

#### Thinking

Now I understand the gacha grade structure. Grades are E, D, C, B, A, S, EX, XS (8 pools). The pools are cumulative — each higher grade pool includes all lower-grade units PLUS new ones. So:
- Pool 1 (E): 5 base units (Atalanta, Gawain, Vlad, Sakura, Kirei)
- Pool 2 (D): those 5 + Rhyme, Medusa, Leesm, Lubu = 9
- Pool 3 (C): those 9 + Tamamo, Zeromodel, Emiya, Andersen, Pendragon, Nero, Alexander, Ryougi, Chulainn, Karna, Alqueid, Passion, Tosaka = 22
- Pool 4 (B): those 22 + Gilgamesh, BB, Bathory, TamamoBikibi, TamamoCasual, Gozen, PendragonAlter, Jeanne, Drake, Altera = 32
- Pool 5 (A): those 32 + JeanneAlter, NeroBride, BathoryAlter, AtalantaAlter = 36
- Pool 6 (S): those 36 + TamamoCathedral (weight 0.5) = 37 (with one at half weight)
- Pool 7 (EX): 15 special EX units (Gilgamesh, Nero, Pendragon, Tamamo, BB, Altera, Tosaka, TamamoSummer, Frankenstein, Jeanne, Medusa, Gawain, Drake, Sakura, MeltPenguin)
- Pool 8 (XS): BB, Altera (unused after 3.80)

So the gacha works by: pick a grade (pool index) based on rates, then PlaceRandomUnit picks uniformly (weighted) from that pool. The grade selection rates are elsewhere. // scope TrigFactionBBHoradricCube begins
    function TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FusionFilter takes nothing returns boolean
        local integer id
        local integer lev
        local integer max
        if IsUnitType(GetFilterUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_DEAD) or GetFilterUnit() == null then
            return false
        endif
        if not IsUnitType(GetFilterUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_TAUREN) then
            return false
        endif
        if GetOwningPlayer(GetFilterUnit()) != TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_PLAYER then
            return false
        endif
        set lev=GetUnitLevel(GetFilterUnit())
        if IsUnitType(GetFilterUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_HERO) then
            set lev=8
        endif
        if lev < 1 or lev > 5 then
            return false
        endif
        set id=GetPlayerId(TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_PLAYER)
        set max=LoadInteger(TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_TABLE, lev, - 1)
        call SaveUnitHandle(TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_TABLE, lev, max, GetFilterUnit())
        call SaveInteger(TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_TABLE, lev, - 1, max + 1)
        return false
    endfunction
    function TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__VoidFusion takes player p returns nothing
        local integer id= GetPlayerId(p)
        local real x= GetPlayerStartLocationX(p)
        local real y= GetPlayerStartLocationY(p)
        local integer result= 0
        local integer i
        local integer j
        local unit u
        set TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_TABLE=InitHashtable()
        set TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_PLAYER=p
        call GroupEnumUnitsInRange(TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_GROUP, x, y, 512.0, TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_FILTER)
        call GroupClear(TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_GROUP)
        set TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_PLAYER=null
        set i=5
        loop
            if LoadInteger(TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_TABLE, i, - 1) >= TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_COUNT then
                set result=i + 1
                set j=0
                loop
                    exitwhen j == TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_COUNT
                    set u=LoadUnitHandle(TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_TABLE, i, j)
                    call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("FX Kiburst\\FX Kiburst Blue.mdl", GetUnitX(u), GetUnitY(u)))
                    call s__servant_remove(p , u)
                    call KillUnit(u)
                    call ShowUnit(u, false)
                    set j=j + 1
                endloop
                set u=null
                exitwhen true
            endif
            exitwhen i == 1
            set i=i - 1
        endloop
        call FlushParentHashtable(TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_TABLE)
        set TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_TABLE=null
        if result == 0 then
            //call SetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER,GetPlayerState(p,PLAYER_STATE_RESOURCE_LUMBER)+1)
            call DisplayTimedTextToPlayer(p, 0.0, 0.0, 10.0, "|c00FF4040At least " + I2S(TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_COUNT) + " units of equal grade must be placed on Fusion Zone.|r")
            return
        endif
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("FX\\ShadowAssault.mdl", x, y))
        set u=s__gacha_do(p , result , x , y , 270.0)
        call s__servant_add(p , u , s__servant_JOHAB)
        call SetUnitVertexColor(u, 32, 32, 32, 255)
        call UnitAddAbility(u, 'A0GM')
        call UnitAddAbility(u, 'A0GN')
        call sc__EVDamageManager_addBonus(u , 50)
        set u=null
    endfunction
    function TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__CheckFusion takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer id= GetPlayerId(GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()))
        if FXGetPlayerCurrentFaction(Player(id)) != FX_FACTION_BB then
            return
        endif
        call TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__VoidFusion(Player(id))
    endfunction
    function TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__SetFusionSystem takes player p returns nothing
        local integer id= GetPlayerId(p)
        local unit u= CreateUnit(p, 'n015', GetPlayerStartLocationX(p), GetPlayerStartLocationY(p), 270.0)
        set TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_BUILDING[id]=u
        set u=null
        //set FUSION_TIMER[id] = CreateTimer()
        //call TimerStart(FUSION_TIMER[id],1.0,true,function CheckFusion)
    endfunction
    function TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__OnConvBuilding takes nothing returns nothing
        if FXGetPlayerCurrentFaction(s__eventCustom_getTriggerPlayer()) == FX_FACTION_BB then
            call TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__SetFusionSystem(s__eventCustom_getTriggerPlayer())
        endif
    endfunction
    //=================================================
    function TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__main takes nothing returns nothing
        set TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FUSION_FILTER=Filter(function TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__FusionFilter)
        call s__AbilityEffectEvent_Create('A0GL' , function TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__CheckFusion)
        call s__eventCustom_addAction(EVENT_PLAYER_BUILDING_SLOT_3 , function TrigFactionBBHoradricCube__OnConvBuilding)
    endfunction

    function TrigSellServantWhenEnterSellZone___ActionFunc takes nothing returns nothing
        local integer lv= GetUnitLevel(GetEnteringUnit())
        local integer sellSetting= FXGetPlayerServantSellSetting(GetOwningPlayer(GetEnteringUnit()))
        if IsUnitType(GetEnteringUnit(), UNIT_TYPE_HERO) then
            set lv=8
        endif
        if sellSetting == 0 then
            return
        elseif sellSetting == 1 then
            if lv > 3 then

        elseif sellSetting == 2 then
            if lv > 5 then

            endif
        endif
        call IssueImmediateOrder(GetEnteringUnit(), "neutralinteract")

        call TriggerRegisterEnterRegion(t, rectRegion, null)

        local player p= GetOwningPlayer(src)

        local integer lev= GetUnitLevel(src)
        local unit u

        call ShowUnit(src, false)
        call KillUnit(src)
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("FX\\Kiara\\Burst.mdl", x, y))
        call s__bountyTag_custom(p , x , y , "|c00FF0000『RNG Interference』|r")
        set u=s__gacha_do(p , lev , x , y , 270.00)
        call s__servant_add(p , u , s__servant_JOHAB)
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffect("FX\\johabTarget.mdl", GetUnitX(u), GetUnitY(u)))
        set p=null
        set u=null
    endfunction

    function FXTrigWispEntersGacha___onEDClassGacha takes player p,unit wisp returns nothing
        local real x= GetPlayerStartLocationX(p)
        local real y= GetPlayerStartLocationY(p)
        local integer rank= GetRandomInt(1, 2)
        local unit u
        call SetUnitTimeScale(wisp, 1.0)

            set rank=1

            set x=GetPlayerStartLocationX(Player(GetPlayerId(p) + 4))
            set y=GetPlayerStartLocationY(Player(GetPlayerId(p) + 4))

        set u=s__gacha_do(p , rank , x , y , 270.0)
        call DestroyEffect(AddSpecialEffectTarget("Abilities\\Spells\\Human\\MassTeleport\\MassTeleportTarget.mdl", u, "origin"))
        call s__servant_add(p , u , s__servant_GACHA)
        set u=null

#### Thinking

Now I understand the core FERD economy/summon loop precisely:

**Wisps** are the central resource. You create wisps (CreateWisp), then move them into different zones:
- **Gacha_Gold zone**: wisp → gold, amount = `GetRandomInt(50 + wav*2, 100 + wav*10)` (scales with wave)
- **Gacha_Lumber zone**: wisp → lumber (H-Spirit points), amount = `GetRandomInt(1,5)`
- **Gacha_Gacha zone**: wisp → servant of grade E or D (`GetRandomInt(1,2)`); before wave 15 forced to E (rank 1)
- **Gacha_EGacha zone**: wisp → servant of grade E (rank 1) always

So the basic summon gives E/D grade servants. Higher grades come from:
- **Johab (recipes)**: combine servants → higher grade specific servants
- **BB faction fusion**: N same-grade → next grade
- **Try Servant Gacha** (gambling tickets): chance at C/B/A/S
- **Special bounty/events**: give B/A/S/EX servants at milestones

And selling servants → wisps (70% for grade ≤3, guaranteed grade >3, amount = grade).

This is the real FERD loop. The grade progression is primarily through **combination (Johab)**, not through summoning high grades directly. You summon E/D fodder, combine them via recipes into C/B/A/S/EX servants.

===CreateWisp===
    function CreateWisp takes player p,integer amt returns nothing
        local integer i= 0
        local integer order= FXRD_AUTOWISP[GetPlayerId(p)]
        local real x= - 6144.00
        local real y= 0
        local boolean hasSkin= HaveSavedInteger(FXWisp___WISP_MODELS, StringHash(USER_NAME[GetPlayerId(p)]), 0)
        local integer skin= LoadInteger(FXWisp___WISP_MODELS, StringHash(USER_NAME[GetPlayerId(p)]), 0)
        local unit u
        loop
            exitwhen i >= amt
            set u=CreateUnit(p, 'wisp', x, y, 270)
            call UnitAddAbility(u, 'A02L')
            call SetUnitTimeScale(u, 0.0)
            if GetLocalPlayer() != p then
                call SetUnitVertexColor(u, 255, 255, 255, 32)
                call SetUnitScale(u, 0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
            endif
            if hasSkin then
                call UnitAddAbility(u, skin)
            endif
            if order > 0 then
                call IssuePointOrder(u, "move", x + sc__Polar_X(512.00 , 90.00 * order), y + sc__Polar_Y(512.00 , 90.00 * order))
            endif
            set i=i + 1
        endloop
        set u=null
    endfunction

        function s__Johab_recipeChk takes player p,integer id,integer vid returns boolean
            local integer i= 0
            local boolean able= true
            local integer uid
            local string s= "ends"
            local string ts
            local integer req
            local integer avl
            set s__Johab_KIND=0
            loop
                set ts=GetAbilityEffectById(id, EFFECT_TYPE_CASTER, i)
                exitwhen ts == null
                exitwhen ts == s
                set s=ts
                set uid=S2A(ts)
                set req=S2I(GetAbilityEffectById(id, EFFECT_TYPE_LIGHTNING, i))
                set s__Johab_KTYP[s__Johab_KIND]=uid
                if vid == uid then
                    set s__Johab_KCNT[s__Johab_KIND]=req - 1
                else
                    set s__Johab_KCNT[s__Johab_KIND]=req
                endif
                set s__Johab_KIND=s__Johab_KIND + 1
                if sc__servant_count(p , uid) < req then
                    set s__Johab_ERRORCODE=uid
                    set able=false
                    exitwhen true
                endif
                set i=i + 1
            endloop
            return able
        endfunction
        
        function s__Johab_KILL takes nothing returns nothing
            local unit v

            endloop
            set s__Johab_ME=null
        endfunction

Excellent! Now I have the complete recipe graph (177 merge recipes). This is the heart of FERD gameplay. The structure is clear:
- Each servant has a grade ladder: E→D→C→B→A→S via recipes (combine lower grades + sometimes a catalyst "Imaginary Structure / Spiritrons Code" -VOC/-VOA)

- EX + -VOA (Imaginary Cyber Daemon) → -BBT (★ Moon Cell Automaton / Holy Grail = BB fusion top)
- Special units (Mashu -MST, LionKing -LKT, Enkidu -ENT, Melt -MLT/-MXT, Semi -SET, Astolfo -AST, HeroinEX -HXT) via specific recipes

119	      return {x:s.x1+(s.x2-s.x1)*t, y:s.y1+(s.y2-s.y1)*t};
120	    }
121	  }
122	  const s=PATH_SEG[PATH_SEG.length-1];
123	  return {x:s.x2,y:s.y2};

138	  g=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(g*f)));
139	  b=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(b*f)));

312	  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.waveActive) return;
313	  S.wave++;
314	  S.waveActive = true;
315	  S.spawnQueue = buildWave(S.wave);
316	  S.spawnT = 0.4;
317	  const boss = S.wave%5===0;
318	  banner(boss ? `⚠ WAVE ${S.wave} — BOSS ⚠` : `WAVE ${S.wave}`);
319	  boss ? AudioFX.boss() : AudioFX.wave();
320	  log(`Wave ${S.wave} incoming${boss?' — a boss approaches!':''}`, boss?'bad':'');
321	  syncStats();
322	}
323	function spawnEnemy(type){
324	  const t = ETYPES[type], w = S.wave;
325	  const hp = Math.round(22 * Math.pow(1.19, w-1) * t.hp * S.diff.hp * (type==='boss'&&w===CFG.finalWave?1.2:1));
326	  S.enemies.push({
327	    uid:uidSeq++, type, d:0, hp, maxHp:hp, sp:t.sp*rand(0.92,1.08), r:t.r, color:t.color,
328	    gold:Math.round((3+w*0.8)*t.gold*S.diff.gold), leak:t.leak, boss:!!t.boss,
329	    armor:t.armor||0, regen:t.regen||0, slowT:0, slowF:0, stunT:0, dots:[], dead:false,
330	  });
331	}
332	function endWave(){
333	  S.waveActive = false;
334	  const interest = Math.min(50, Math.floor(S.gold*0.08));
335	  const bonus = Math.round((35 + S.wave*6) * S.diff.gold) + interest;
336	  S.gold += bonus; S.goldEarned += bonus;
337	  log(`Wave ${S.wave} cleared! +◈${bonus}${interest?` (incl. ${interest} interest)`:''}`, 'gold');
338	  bump($('stGold').parentElement);
339	  if (S.wave >= CFG.finalWave) return gameOver(true);
340	  if (S.auto) S.autoT = 2.5;
341	  syncStats();
342	}
343	function gameOver(win){
344	  S.mode = win?'won':'lost';
345	  win ? AudioFX.win() : AudioFX.lose();
346	  const mins = Math.floor((S.time)/60), secs = Math.floor(S.time%60);
347	  $('endTitle').textContent = win ? '✦ GRAIL SECURED ✦' : 'THE MOON CELL FALLS';
348	  $('endTitle').className = win?'win':'lose';
349	  $('endSub').textContent = win
350	    ? `All ${CFG.finalWave} waves repelled on ${S.diff.name}. The simulation is yours.`
351	    : `Overrun on wave ${S.wave} (${S.diff.name}). The grail slips away…`;
352	  $('endStats').innerHTML = [
353	    [S.wave, 'WAVES'], [S.kills, 'KILLS'], [S.summons, 'SUMMONS'],
354	    [S.ascensions, 'ASCENSIONS'], [Math.floor(S.goldEarned), 'GOLD EARNED'], [`${mins}:${String(secs).padStart(2,'0')}`, 'TIME'],
355	  ].map(([v,l])=>`<div><b>${v}</b><span>${l}</span></div>`).join('');
356	  $('endOverlay').classList.add('show');
357	}

359	/* ---------------- combat ---------------- */
360	function dmgMult(){ return 1 + 0.12 * S.field.filter(u=>u&&u.id==='mira').length; }
361	function damageEnemy(e, dmg, opts={}){
362	  if (e.dead) return;
363	  const real = dmg * (1 - e.armor);
364	  e.hp -= real;
365	  if (opts.dot) e.dots.push({ dps:opts.dot, t:opts.dotT||2 });
366	  if (opts.slow){ e.slowT = Math.max(e.slowT, opts.slowT||1.2); e.slowF = Math.max(e.slowF, opts.slow); }
367	  if (opts.stun) e.stunT = Math.max(e.stunT, opts.stun);
368	  if (opts.greed){ S.gold += opts.greed; S.goldEarned += opts.greed; }
369	  const p = pathPos(e.d);
370	  if (opts.crit || real >= 60) float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, Math.round(real), opts.crit?'#ffc93d':'#f2ead8', opts.crit?15:11);
371	  if (e.hp <= 0){
372	    e.dead = true;
373	    S.kills++; S.gold += e.gold; S.goldEarned += e.gold;
374	    burst(p.x, p.y, e.color, e.boss?30:8);
375	    if (e.boss){ S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, 9); ringFx(p.x,p.y,e.color,80); log(`Boss destroyed! +◈${e.gold}`, 'good'); }
376	    AudioFX.kill();
377	    bump($('stGold').parentElement);
378	    syncStats();
379	  } else AudioFX.hit();
380	}
381	function enemiesInRange(x,y,r){
382	  const out=[];
383	  for (const e of S.enemies){
384	    if (e.dead) continue;
385	    const p=pathPos(e.d);
386	    if ((p.x-x)**2+(p.y-y)**2 <= r*r) out.push({e,p});
387	  }
388	  return out;
389	}
390	function unitAttack(u, def, x, y){
391	  const inR = enemiesInRange(x,y,def.range);
392	  if (!inR.length) return false;
393	  inR.sort((a,b)=>b.e.d-a.e.d);
394	  const first = inR[0];
395	  const mult = dmgMult();
396	  const g = GRADES[def.grade];
397	  AudioFX.shoot();
398	  const fire = (target, dmg, extra={}) => {
399	    S.projectiles.push({ uid:uidSeq++, x, y, t:target.e, tx:target.p.x, ty:target.p.y, sp:460, dmg, color:g.color, def, ...extra });
400	  };
401	  switch (def.kind){
402	    case 'single': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {greed:def.greed}); break;
403	    case 'crit': {
404	      const crit = Math.random() < (def.critC||0.25);
405	      fire(first, def.dmg*mult*(crit?(def.critX||2):1), {crit, greed:def.greed});
406	      break;
407	    }
408	    case 'slow': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {slow:def.slow, slowT:def.slowT, aoe:def.aoe}); break;
409	    case 'stun': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, stunC:def.stunC, stunT:def.stunT}); break;
410	    case 'aoe': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe||40}); break;
411	    case 'burn': case 'poison': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe||40, dot:def.dot, dotT:def.dotT}); break;
412	    case 'pierce': {
413	      const targets = [first, ...inR.slice(1).filter(o=>(o.p.x-first.p.x)**2+(o.p.y-first.p.y)**2<95*95).slice(0,(def.pierce||2)-1)];
414	      targets.forEach(t=>fire(t, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, fast:true}));
415	      break;
416	    }
417	    case 'multi': {
418	      const n = def.multi||2;
419	      for (let i=0;i<n;i++) fire(inR[i%inR.length], def.dmg*mult, {dot:def.dot, dotT:def.dotT});
420	      break;
421	    }
422	    case 'chain': {
423	      let cur = first; const hit=new Set(); const pts=[{x,y}];
424	      let dmg = def.dmg*mult;
425	      for (let i=0;i<(def.chain||3);i++){
426	        if (!cur) break;
427	        hit.add(cur.e);
428	        pts.push({x:cur.p.x,y:cur.p.y});
429	        damageEnemy(cur.e, dmg, {});
430	        dmg *= 0.75;
431	        const next = S.enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead&&!hit.has(e)).map(e=>({e,p:pathPos(e.d)}))
432	          .filter(o=>(o.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(o.p.y-cur.p.y)**2<130*130)
433	          .sort((a,b)=>((a.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(a.p.y-cur.p.y)**2)-((b.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(b.p.y-cur.p.y)**2))[0];
434	        cur = next;
435	      }
436	      S.beams.push({uid:uidSeq++, pts, t:0, life:0.18, color:g.color, w:2.5, lightning:true});
437	      break;
438	    }
439	    case 'beam': {
440	      damageEnemy(first.e, def.dmg*mult, {});
441	      if (def.aoe){
442	        S.enemies.forEach(e=>{
443	          if (e.dead || e===first.e) return;
444	          const p=pathPos(e.d);
445	          if ((p.x-first.p.x)**2+(p.y-first.p.y)**2 < def.aoe*def.aoe) damageEnemy(e, def.dmg*mult*0.7, {});
446	        });
447	        ringFx(first.p.x, first.p.y, g.color, def.aoe);
448	      }
449	      S.beams.push({uid:uidSeq++, pts:[{x,y},{x:first.p.x,y:first.p.y}], t:0, life:0.16, color:g.color, w:def.aoe?5:3});
450	      burst(first.p.x, first.p.y, g.color, 5);
451	      break;
452	    }
453	  }
454	  return true;
455	}
456	function projectileImpact(pr){
457	  const hitOne = (e)=>{
458	    damageEnemy(e, pr.dmg, {
459	      crit:pr.crit, dot:pr.dot, dotT:pr.dotT, slow:pr.slow, slowT:pr.slowT,
460	      stun:(pr.stunC && Math.random()<pr.stunC)?pr.stunT:0, greed:pr.greed,
461	    });
462	  };
463	  if (pr.aoe){
464	    S.enemies.forEach(e=>{
465	      if (e.dead) return;
466	      const p=pathPos(e.d);
467	      if ((p.x-pr.tx)**2+(p.y-pr.ty)**2 <= pr.aoe*pr.aoe) hitOne(e);
468	    });
469	    ringFx(pr.tx, pr.ty, pr.color, pr.aoe);
470	  } else if (pr.t && !pr.t.dead) hitOne(pr.t);
471	  burst(pr.tx, pr.ty, pr.color, 3);
472	}

474	/* ---------------- effects (data only; rendered in 3D) ---------------- */
475	function burst(x,y,color,n){
476	  for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
477	    const a=rand(0,Math.PI*2), sp=rand(30,150);
478	    S.particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*sp,vy:Math.sin(a)*sp,t:0,life:rand(0.3,0.7),color,r:rand(1.5,3.5)});
479	  }
480	  if (S.particles.length>400) S.particles.splice(0, S.particles.length-400);
481	}
482	function ringFx(x,y,color,r){ S.rings.push({x,y,color,r,t:0,life:0.4}); }
483	function float(x,y,txt,color,size){
484	  S.floats.push({x:x+rand(-6,6),y,txt:String(txt),color,size,t:0,life:0.8});
485	  if (S.floats.length>60) S.floats.shift();
486	}

488	/* ---------------- update (driven by the 3D loop) ---------------- */
489	function update(dt){
490	  S.time += dt;
491	  if (S.waveActive && S.spawnQueue.length){
492	    S.spawnT -= dt;
493	    if (S.spawnT <= 0){
494	      const type = S.spawnQueue.shift();
495	      spawnEnemy(type);
496	      S.spawnT = type==='boss' ? 1.6 : Math.max(0.35, 0.95 - S.wave*0.02);
497	    }
498	  }
499	  if (S.auto && !S.waveActive && S.mode==='play' && S.wave>0 && S.wave<CFG.finalWave){
500	    S.autoT -= dt;
501	    if (S.autoT<=0) startWave();
502	  }
503	  for (const e of S.enemies){
504	    if (e.dead) continue;
505	    if (e.slowT>0) e.slowT-=dt;
506	    if (e.stunT>0) e.stunT-=dt;
507	    for (const d of e.dots){ d.t-=dt; if (d.t>0){ e.hp -= d.dps*dt*(1-e.armor); } }
508	    e.dots = e.dots.filter(d=>d.t>0);
509	    if (e.regen) e.hp = Math.min(e.maxHp, e.hp + e.maxHp*e.regen*dt);
510	    if (e.hp<=0){
511	      e.dead=true; S.kills++; S.gold+=e.gold; S.goldEarned+=e.gold;
512	      const p=pathPos(e.d); burst(p.x,p.y,'#5dc86a',6); AudioFX.kill(); syncStats();
513	      continue;
514	    }
515	    const slow = e.slowT>0 ? 1-e.slowF : 1;
516	    e.d += e.sp * slow * (e.stunT>0?0:1) * dt;
517	    if (e.d >= PATH_LEN){
518	      e.dead = true;
519	      S.lives -= e.leak;
520	      S.leakFlash = 0.5; S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, e.boss?10:5);
521	      AudioFX.leak();
522	      log(`${e.boss?'BOSS':'Enemy'} leaked! −${e.leak} ♥`, 'bad');
523	      bump($('stLives').parentElement);
524	      syncStats();
525	      if (S.lives<=0){ S.lives=0; syncStats(); return gameOver(false); }
526	    }
527	  }
528	  S.enemies = S.enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead);
529	  if (S.waveActive && !S.spawnQueue.length && !S.enemies.length) endWave();
530	  S.field.forEach((u,i)=>{
531	    if (!u) return;
532	    u.cd -= dt;
533	    if (u.cd<=0){
534	      const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id], s = SLOTS[i];
535	      if (unitAttack(u, def, s.x, s.y)) u.cd = 1/def.rate;
536	      else u.cd = 0.08;
537	    }
538	  });
539	  for (const pr of S.projectiles){
540	    if (pr.t && !pr.t.dead){ const p=pathPos(pr.t.d); pr.tx=p.x; pr.ty=p.y; }
541	    const dx=pr.tx-pr.x, dy=pr.ty-pr.y, dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
542	    const step=(pr.fast?640:pr.sp)*dt;
543	    if (dist<=step+4){ pr.done=true; projectileImpact(pr); }
544	    else { pr.x+=dx/dist*step; pr.y+=dy/dist*step; }
545	  }
546	  S.projectiles = S.projectiles.filter(p=>!p.done);
547	  for (const b of S.beams) b.t+=dt;
548	  S.beams = S.beams.filter(b=>b.t<b.life);
549	  for (const r of S.rings) r.t+=dt;
550	  S.rings = S.rings.filter(r=>r.t<r.life);
551	  for (const p of S.particles){ p.t+=dt; p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.vx*=0.96; p.vy*=0.96; }
552	  S.particles = S.particles.filter(p=>p.t<p.life);
553	  for (const f of S.floats){ f.t+=dt; f.y-=28*dt; }
554	  S.floats = S.floats.filter(f=>f.t<f.life);
555	  S.shake = Math.max(0, S.shake - dt*22);
556	  S.leakFlash = Math.max(0, S.leakFlash - dt);
557	}

#### Thinking

Now I fully understand the architecture. The game.js is well-structured and the 3D layer drives `update()`. The data model is:
- GRADES with color/weight/sell
- UNITS with combat stats + kind
- RECIPES (base + mats → result)
- DIFFICULTIES
- CFG, PATH, SLOTS

To make this faithful to FERD, I need to:
1. Expand GRADES to E/D/C/B/A/S/EX (+ ★ BB)
2. Expand the roster to ~30+ bases mapped to original anime names, with the full grade ladder
3. Encode the full recipe graph (the 177 recipes, but mapped to original names — I can include the meaningful subset that forms complete ladders)
4. Cumulative gacha pools
5. Wisp economy (FERD's distinctive mechanic)
6. 12 difficulties with real waves/lives/HP×/speed×

#### Thinking

So faction XP is awarded at END of game (victory: LEVEL_XP[current level] + bonus; defeat: partial based on waves progressed). It's a meta-progression across games (savecode). Faction level persists across runs via savecode. That's a persistent meta-progression, not per-run.

For a web game, persistent faction level across runs = localStorage persistence. That's a nice faithful touch: faction XP awarded at game end (win full, loss partial), faction level 1-15 persists, mastering (15) unlocks master level (transcend) and a master bonus.

But implementing full savecode meta-progression is heavy. However the user explicitly asks for the faction system. I should implement a faithful, playable faction system:
- 5 factions selectable (and switchable) with original names/colors/icons.
- Each faction has a signature passive + an active ability (usable via a button / the faction tower), scaling with faction level.
- Faction level/XP meta-progression persisted in localStorage, awarded at game end (win/loss partial), max 15 then mastered.
- Faction-specific mechanics:
  - Nero→gold: kill gold bonus, start gold bonus, super gamble (high-cost gacha), dormus boost.
  - Tamamo→skill: wisp-cost servant reroll (change servant), enhanced actives (starfall AoE, nuclear big AoE, boost), MP/mana regen → in our game maybe "spirit regen per wave".
  - Altera→wisp: kill wisp bonus, seal (disable enemy abilities / slow).
  - Another→double: double servant on combine (johab/ascend duplicates), fix target (force focus).
  - BB→fusion: fuse N same-grade → next grade (Horadric Cube).

That's a big but doable feature. Given the directive to build complete and test, I'll implement a coherent faction system that captures each faction's identity with real working mechanics, faction selection UI, faction level/XP with persistence, and faction active abilities button.

177	    return { id:mid, have:!!found, ref:found };

/* ---------------- factions ---------------- */
const FSAVE_KEY='aerd_factions_v1';
let factionSave = loadFactionSave();
function loadFactionSave(){
  const base={cur:'aurel', fac:{}};
  FACTIONS.forEach(f=>base.fac[f.key]={lv:1,xp:0});
  try{
    const raw=localStorage.getItem(FSAVE_KEY);
    if(raw){ const p=JSON.parse(raw); if(p&&p.fac){ base.cur=FACTION_BY_KEY[p.cur]?p.cur:'aurel'; FACTIONS.forEach(f=>{ const s=p.fac[f.key]; if(s&&typeof s.lv==='number'){ base.fac[f.key]={lv:Math.min(FACTION_MAX_LEVEL,Math.max(1,s.lv|0)), xp:Math.max(0,s.xp|0)}; } }); } }
  }catch(e){}
  return base;
}
function persistFactionSave(){ try{ localStorage.setItem(FSAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(factionSave)); }catch(e){} }
const curFaction = () => FACTION_BY_KEY[factionSave.cur];
const facLevel = () => factionSave.fac[factionSave.cur].lv;
const facMul = () => 1 + (facLevel()-1)*0.05;
const facMastered = () => facLevel()>=FACTION_MAX_LEVEL;
function addFactionXp(amount){
  const f=factionSave.cur, st=factionSave.fac[f];
  if (st.lv>=FACTION_MAX_LEVEL){ persistFactionSave(); return; }
  st.xp += Math.round(amount);
  let leveled=false;
  while (st.lv<FACTION_MAX_LEVEL && st.xp>=FACTION_XP_REQ[st.lv-1]){ st.xp-=FACTION_XP_REQ[st.lv-1]; st.lv++; leveled=true; }
  if (st.lv>=FACTION_MAX_LEVEL) st.xp=0;
  persistFactionSave();
  if (leveled){ AudioFX.ascend(); toast(`⚑ ${curFaction().name} reached Lv${st.lv}${st.lv>=FACTION_MAX_LEVEL?' — MASTERED!':''}`); log(`⚑ Faction level up → ${curFaction().name} Lv${st.lv}`, 'epic'); }
  syncFaction();
}
function setFaction(key){
  if (!FACTION_BY_KEY[key]) return;
  factionSave.cur=key; persistFactionSave(); AudioFX.click();
  log(`⚑ Sworn to ${curFaction().name} (${curFaction().tag})`, 'good');
  syncFaction(); syncStats();
}

437	const PATH = [
438	  [-30,320],[200,320],[200,130],[760,130],[760,510],[200,510],[200,320],
439	  [200,130],[760,130],[760,320],[990,320],
440	];
441	const PATH_SEG = []; let PATH_LEN = 0;
442	for (let i=0;i<PATH.length-1;i++){
443	  const [x1,y1]=PATH[i],[x2,y2]=PATH[i+1];
444	  const len=Math.hypot(x2-x1,y2-y1);
445	  PATH_SEG.push({x1,y1,x2,y2,len,start:PATH_LEN}); PATH_LEN+=len;
446	}
447	function pathPos(d){
448	  d=Math.max(0,Math.min(PATH_LEN,d));
449	  for (const s of PATH_SEG){ if (d<=s.start+s.len){ const t=(d-s.start)/s.len;
450	    return {x:s.x1+(s.x2-s.x1)*t, y:s.y1+(s.y2-s.y1)*t}; } }
451	  const s=PATH_SEG[PATH_SEG.length-1]; return {x:s.x2,y:s.y2};
452	}

462	function shade(hex,f){
463	  const n=parseInt(hex.slice(1),16);
464	  let r=(n>>16)&255,g=(n>>8)&255,b=n&255;
465	  r=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(r*f)));
466	  g=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(g*f)));
467	  b=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(b*f)));
468	  return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
469	}

410	function makeBeam(b) {
411	  const g = new THREE.Group();
412	  const mats = [];
413	  const col = C(b.color);
414	  const radius = b.w * WS * 0.6;
415	  const pts = b.pts;
416	  for (let i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
417	    const a = new THREE.Vector3(wx(pts[i].x), 1.0, wz(pts[i].y));
418	    const bb = new THREE.Vector3(wx(pts[i + 1].x), 1.0, wz(pts[i + 1].y));
419	    const segs = b.lightning ? 4 : 1;
420	    let prev = a;
421	    for (let s = 1; s <= segs; s++) {
422	      const t = s / segs;
423	      const cur = a.clone().lerp(bb, t);
424	      if (b.lightning && s < segs) {
425	        cur.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5; cur.z += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5; cur.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4;
426	      }
427	      const dir = cur.clone().sub(prev); const len = dir.length();
428	      const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: col, transparent: true, opacity: 1, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false });
429	      mats.push(mat);
430	      const m = new THREE.Mesh(geo('beamSeg', () => new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1, 1, 6)), mat);
431	      m.scale.set(radius, len, radius);
432	      m.position.copy(prev).add(cur).multiplyScalar(0.5);
433	      m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dir.normalize());
434	      g.add(m); prev = cur;
435	    }
436	  }
437	  world.add(g);
438	  return { group: g, mats };
439	}

482	function syncUnits(S, elapsed) {
483	  const live = new Set();
484	  S.field.forEach((u, i) => {
485	    if (!u) return;
486	    live.add(i);
487	    let ent = unitMap.get(i);
488	    if (!ent || ent.uid !== u.uid || ent.id !== u.id) {
489	      if (ent) { world.remove(ent.group); }
490	      const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id];
491	      const group = makeUnit(def);
492	      group.position.set(platforms[i].x, 0.56, platforms[i].z);
493	      world.add(group);
494	      ent = { group, uid: u.uid, id: u.id, def };
495	      unitMap.set(i, ent);
496	    }
497	    const g = ent.group;
498	    g.position.y = 0.56 + Math.sin(elapsed * 2 + i) * 0.05;
499	    if (g.userData.gem) { g.userData.gem.rotation.y = elapsed * 1.5; g.userData.gem.rotation.x = elapsed * 0.7; }
500	    if (g.userData.halo) g.userData.halo.rotation.z = elapsed * 0.8;
501	    /* face nearest enemy in range */
502	    const def = ent.def; let best = null, bd = Infinity;
503	    for (const e of S.enemies) {
504	      if (e.dead) continue;
505	      const p = pathPos(e.d);
506	      const d = (p.x - SLOTS[i].x) ** 2 + (p.y - SLOTS[i].y) ** 2;
507	      if (d < def.range * def.range && d < bd) { bd = d; best = p; }
508	    }
509	    if (best) {
510	      const ang = Math.atan2(wx(best.x) - g.position.x, wz(best.y) - g.position.z);
511	      let cur = g.rotation.y;
512	      let diff = ((ang - cur + Math.PI) % (Math.PI * 2) + Math.PI * 2) % (Math.PI * 2) - Math.PI;
513	      g.rotation.y = cur + diff * 0.15;
514	    } else {
515	      g.rotation.y += 0.003;
516	    }
517	  });
518	  for (const [i, ent] of unitMap) {
519	    if (!live.has(i)) { world.remove(ent.group); unitMap.delete(i); }
520	  }
521	}

523	function syncEnemies(S, elapsed, dt) {
524	  const live = new Set();
525	  for (const e of S.enemies) {
526	    if (e.dead) continue;
527	    live.add(e.uid);
528	    let ent = enemyMap.get(e.uid);
529	    if (!ent) { ent = makeEnemy(e); enemyMap.set(e.uid, ent); }
530	    const p = pathPos(e.d);
531	    const X = wx(p.x), Z = wz(p.y);
532	    const hover = (e.boss ? 1.1 : 0.75) + Math.sin(elapsed * 3 + e.uid) * 0.12;
533	    ent.group.position.set(X, hover, Z);
534	    ent.core.rotation.y += dt * 1.4; ent.core.rotation.x += dt * 0.6;
535	    if (ent.group.userData.cage) { ent.group.userData.cage.rotation.y -= dt * 0.9; ent.group.userData.cage.rotation.z += dt * 0.4; }
536	    ent.shadow.position.set(X, 0.07, Z);
537	    const ratio = clamp(e.hp / e.maxHp, 0, 1);
538	    ent.fill.scale.x = Math.max(0.001, ent.barW * ratio);
539	    ent.fill.material.color.set(ratio > 0.5 ? '#3dff9a' : ratio > 0.25 ? '#ffd23d' : '#ff3d5e');
540	    ent.hpGroup.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
541	    /* status */
542	    if (e.slowT > 0) { ent.status.visible = true; ent.status.material.color.set('#35e0ff'); }
543	    else if (e.stunT > 0) { ent.status.visible = true; ent.status.material.color.set('#ffd23d'); }
544	    else if (e.dots.length) { ent.status.visible = true; ent.status.material.color.set('#ff3d8e'); }
545	    else ent.status.visible = false;
546	    if (ent.status.visible) ent.status.rotation.z = elapsed * 2;
547	    ent.coreMat.emissiveIntensity = 0.55 + Math.sin(elapsed * 4 + e.uid) * 0.2;
548	  }
549	  for (const [uid, ent] of enemyMap) {
550	    if (!live.has(uid)) {
551	      world.remove(ent.group); world.remove(ent.shadow);
552	      ent.coreMat.dispose(); ent.fill.material.dispose(); ent.status.material.dispose();
553	      ent.glow.material.dispose();
554	      enemyMap.delete(uid);
555	    }
556	  }
557	}

419	  $('stPop').textContent = `${popUsed()} / ${CFG.popCap}`;

422	  $('gachaGrade').textContent = GRADES[sg].label;

427	  const up = $('gachaUpBtn');

429	  else { const c=CFG.gachaUpCost(S.gachaLv); up.disabled=S.mode!=='play'||S.spirit<c; up.innerHTML=`▲ Upgrade Gacha <span class="cost">✧ ${c}</span>`; }
430	  $('wispGold').disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1;
431	  $('wispSpirit').disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1;
432	  $('wispGacha').disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1 || !S.bench.includes(null);

436	  wb.innerHTML = S.waveActive ? `≋ Wave ${S.wave}…` : (S.wave===0?'▶ Start Wave':`▶ Wave ${S.wave+1}`);
437	  $('benchN').textContent = `${S.bench.filter(Boolean).length}/${CFG.benchSize}`;

440	function renderBench(newIdx=-1){

448	      const img = document.createElement('img');

450	      d.appendChild(img);

464	function recipesFor(id){ return RECIPES.map((r,i)=>({...r,ri:i})).filter(r=>r.base===id); }
465	function matStatus(recipe, baseRef){
466	  const pool = allUnits().filter(x=>!(x.loc===baseRef.loc && x.idx===baseRef.idx));
467	  const used = new Set();
468	  return recipe.mats.map(mid=>{
469	    const found = pool.find(x=>x.u.id===mid && !used.has(x.u.uid));
470	    if (found) used.add(found.u.uid);
471	    return { id:mid, have:!!found, ref:found };
472	  });
473	}
474	function renderSelected(){
475	  const none = $('selNone'), card = $('selCard');
476	  const ref = S.sel && (S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench[S.sel.idx]:S.field[S.sel.idx]);
477	  if (!ref){ none.style.display='block'; card.style.display='none'; return; }
478	  none.style.display='none'; card.style.display='flex';
479	  const u = UNIT_BY_ID[ref.id], g = GRADES[u.grade];

484	    (S.sel.loc==='field'?'<span style="color:var(--success)">deployed</span>':'<span style="color:var(--info)">on bench</span>');
485	  $('ssDmg').textContent = u.dmg; $('ssRate').textContent = u.rate; $('ssRange').textContent = u.range;
486	  $('selDesc').textContent = u.desc;
487	  $('sellBtn').textContent = `Release → ❋${Math.max(1,Math.round(gradeVal(u.grade)/2))}`;
488	  $('ascendBtn').style.display='none';

493	  rbox.innerHTML = '<div class="rt">▲ ASCENSION PATHS</div>';
494	  recs.forEach(r=>{

499	    const row = document.createElement('div');
500	    row.style.cssText='margin-bottom:8px';
501	    row.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:${GRADES[res.grade].color};margin-bottom:5px">→ ${res.name} <span style="color:var(--ink-faint);font-weight:400">(⛨${res.pop})</span></div>`;
502	    const chips = document.createElement('div'); chips.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px';
503	    status.forEach(m=>{
504	      const mu = UNIT_BY_ID[m.id];
505	      const c = document.createElement('div');
506	      c.className = 'matChip ' + (m.have?'have':'miss');
507	      c.innerHTML = `<img src="${portraitSVG(mu)}" style="border-color:${GRADES[mu.grade].color}">[${mu.grade}] ${mu.name}`;
508	      chips.appendChild(c);
509	    });
510	    row.appendChild(chips);
511	    const btn = document.createElement('button');
512	    btn.textContent = ok ? (popOk?'▲ ASCEND':'⛨ POP FULL') : 'MATERIALS MISSING';
513	    btn.disabled = !ok || !popOk;
514	    btn.style.cssText='width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#a62e5b,var(--gEX));border:1px solid rgba(255,61,94,.5)';
515	    btn.onclick = ()=>ascend(r.ri);
516	    row.appendChild(btn);
517	    rbox.appendChild(row);
518	  });

521	/* ---------------- summon (gacha building) ---------------- */
522	function giveServant(grade, source){
523	  const idx = S.bench.indexOf(null);
524	  if (idx===-1){ toast('Bench is full!', true); return false; }
525	  const pool = GACHA_POOL[grade];
526	  const id = pick(pool);
527	  const u = UNIT_BY_ID[id];
528	  S.bench[idx] = { uid:uidSeq++, id, cd:0 };
529	  AudioFX.summon(grade);
530	  const epic = grade==='S'||grade==='EX'||grade==='STAR';
531	  log(`${source} [${GRADES[grade].label}] ${u.name}`, epic?'epic':grade==='A'?'gold':'');
532	  if (epic) toast(`✦ ${GRADES[grade].label}-GRADE! ${u.name} answers the call!`);
533	  renderBench(idx); syncStats();
534	  if (S.sel) renderSelected();
535	  return true;
536	}
537	function summon(){
538	  if (S.mode!=='play') return;
539	  const cost = summonCost();
540	  if (S.gold < cost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);
541	  if (!S.bench.includes(null)) return toast('Bench is full!', true);
542	  S.gold -= cost; S.summons++;
543	  let lv = S.gachaLv;
544	  S.pity++;
545	  if (S.pity >= CFG.pityEvery){ lv = Math.min(CFG.gachaMaxLv, lv+1); S.pity = 0; }
546	  const grade = GACHA_GRADE[lv-1];
547	  if (grade==='S') S.pity = 0;
548	  bump($('stGold').parentElement);
549	  giveServant(grade, 'Summoned');
550	}
551	function upgradeGacha(){
552	  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.gachaLv>=CFG.gachaMaxLv) return;
553	  const c = CFG.gachaUpCost(S.gachaLv);
554	  if (S.spirit < c) return toast('Not enough spirit!', true);
555	  S.spirit -= c; S.gachaLv++;
556	  AudioFX.ascend();
557	  const g = summonGrade();
558	  log(`▲ Gacha upgraded to Lv${S.gachaLv} — now summons [${GRADES[g].label}]`, 'gold');
559	  toast(`▲ Gacha Lv${S.gachaLv}: [${GRADES[g].label}]-grade unlocked!`);
560	  bump($('stSpirit').parentElement);
561	  syncStats();
562	}

590	function tryPlace(slotIdx){

604	function sellSelected(){
605	  if (!S.sel) return;
606	  const arr = S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
607	  const u = arr[S.sel.idx]; if (!u) return;
608	  const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id];

613	  log(`Released ${def.name} → ❋${w} wisp${w>1?'s':''}`, 'good');

617	function ascend(ri){
618	  const r = RECIPES[ri];
619	  if (!S.sel) return;
620	  const baseArr = S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
621	  const base = baseArr[S.sel.idx];
622	  if (!base || base.id!==r.base) return;
623	  const status = matStatus(r, S.sel);
624	  if (!status.every(m=>m.have)) return toast('Materials missing!', true);
625	  const res = UNIT_BY_ID[r.result];
626	  const baseDef = UNIT_BY_ID[base.id];
627	  if (S.sel.loc==='field' && popUsed()-baseDef.pop+res.pop > CFG.popCap)
628	    return toast('Not enough population!', true);
629	  status.forEach(m=>{
630	    const arr = m.ref.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
631	    arr[m.ref.idx] = null;
632	  });
633	  base.id = r.result; base.cd = 0;
634	  S.ascensions++;
635	  addFactionXp(200);
636	  if (curFaction().key==='echo' && Math.random()<0.05*facMul() && S.bench.includes(null)){
637	    const idx=S.bench.indexOf(null);
638	    S.bench[idx]={uid:uidSeq++, id:r.result, cd:0};
639	    log(`⧉ Doubled output → free copy of ${res.name}`, 'epic');
640	    toast(`⧉ Echo copy: ${res.name}!`);
641	  }
642	  AudioFX.ascend();
643	  const pos = S.sel.loc==='field' ? SLOTS[S.sel.idx] : null;
644	  const rc = GRADES[res.grade].color;
645	  if (pos){ ringFx(pos.x,pos.y,rc,90); ringFx(pos.x,pos.y,'#ffd23d',60); burst(pos.x,pos.y,rc,26); S.shake=Math.max(S.shake,6); }
646	  banner(res.grade==='STAR'?'★ MOON CELL AUTOMATON ★':res.grade==='EX'?'▲ EX ASCENSION ▲':'▲ ASCENSION ▲');
647	  log(`▲ ASCENDED into ${res.name}!`, 'epic');
648	  toast(`▲ ${res.name} awakens!`);
649	  renderBench(); renderSelected(); syncStats();
650	}

652	/* ---------------- waves & enemies ---------------- */
653	function buildWave(w){
654	  const q = [];
655	  const count = Math.min(30, 8 + Math.floor(w*0.55));
656	  const isBoss = w%5===0;
657	  for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
658	    let type='normal';
659	    const r=Math.random();
660	    if (w>=20 && r<0.16) type='regen';
661	    else if (w>=10 && r<0.36) type='armor';
662	    else if (w>=4 && r<0.60) type='swift';
663	    q.push(type);
664	  }
665	  if (isBoss) q.push(w%10===0?'bigboss':'boss');
666	  return q;
667	}
668	const ETYPES = {
669	  normal:{ hp:1,   sp:74,  r:9,  color:'#ff7a4d', gold:1,   leak:1 },
670	  swift: { hp:0.6, sp:120, r:7,  color:'#3de0c8', gold:1,   leak:1 },
671	  armor: { hp:1.6, sp:58,  r:10, color:'#9ab0c8', gold:1.4, leak:1, armor:0.3 },
672	  regen: { hp:1.2, sp:66,  r:9,  color:'#5dc86a', gold:1.3, leak:1, regen:0.02 },
673	  boss:  { hp:8,  sp:46,  r:17, color:'#e14dff', gold:12,  leak:5, boss:true },
674	  bigboss:{hp:16, sp:40,  r:21, color:'#ff3d5e', gold:25,  leak:8, boss:true },
675	};
676	function startWave(){
677	  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.waveActive) return;
678	  S.wave++;
679	  S.waveActive = true;
680	  S.spawnQueue = buildWave(S.wave);
681	  S.spawnT = 0.4;
682	  const boss = S.wave%5===0;
683	  banner(boss ? `⚠ WAVE ${S.wave} — BOSS ⚠` : `WAVE ${S.wave}`);
684	  boss ? AudioFX.boss() : AudioFX.wave();
685	  log(`Wave ${S.wave} incoming${boss?' — a boss approaches!':''}`, boss?'bad':'');
686	  syncStats();
687	}
688	function spawnEnemy(type){
689	  const t = ETYPES[type], w = S.wave;
690	  const finalBoss = t.boss && w===S.diff.waves;
691	  const hp = Math.round((10 + 4*w + 0.5*w*w) * t.hp * S.diff.hp * (finalBoss?1.5:1));
692	  S.enemies.push({
693	    uid:uidSeq++, type, d:0, hp, maxHp:hp, sp:t.sp*S.diff.speed*rand(0.92,1.08), r:t.r, color:t.color,
694	    gold:Math.round((3+w*0.7)*t.gold*S.diff.gold), leak:t.leak, boss:!!t.boss,
695	    armor:t.armor||0, regen:t.regen||0, slowT:0, slowF:0, stunT:0, dots:[], dead:false,
696	  });
697	}
698	function endWave(){
699	  S.waveActive = false;
700	  const interest = Math.min(60, Math.floor(S.gold*0.08));
701	  const bonus = Math.round((30 + S.wave*5) * S.diff.gold) + interest;
702	  S.gold += bonus; S.goldEarned += bonus;
703	  S.wisps += CFG.wispsPerWave;
704	  const spiritReward = curFaction().key==='kitsune' ? 2 : 1;
705	  S.spirit += spiritReward;
706	  addFactionXp(500);
707	  log(`Wave ${S.wave} cleared! +◈${bonus}${interest?` (${interest} interest)`:''} · +❋${CFG.wispsPerWave} · +✧${spiritReward}`, 'gold');
708	  bump($('stGold').parentElement);
709	  if (S.wave >= S.diff.waves) return gameOver(true);
710	  if (S.auto) S.autoT = 2.0;
711	  syncStats();
712	}
713	function gameOver(win){
714	  S.mode = win?'won':'lost';
715	  addFactionXp(win?20000:S.wave*500);
716	  win ? AudioFX.win() : AudioFX.lose();
717	  const mins = Math.floor((S.time)/60), secs = Math.floor(S.time%60);
718	  $('endTitle').textContent = win ? '✦ GRAIL SECURED ✦' : 'THE MOON CELL FALLS';
719	  $('endTitle').className = win?'win':'lose';
720	  $('endSub').textContent = win
721	    ? `All ${S.diff.waves} waves repelled on ${S.diff.name}. The simulation is yours.`
722	    : `Overrun on wave ${S.wave} (${S.diff.name}). The grail slips away…`;
723	  $('endSub').textContent += ` ⚑ ${curFaction().name} ${facMastered()?'MASTER':'Lv'+facLevel()}.`;
724	  $('endStats').innerHTML = [
725	    [S.wave, 'WAVES'], [S.kills, 'KILLS'], [S.summons, 'SUMMONS'],
726	    [S.ascensions, 'ASCENSIONS'], [Math.floor(S.goldEarned), 'GOLD EARNED'], [`${mins}:${String(secs).padStart(2,'0')}`, 'TIME'],
727	  ].map(([v,l])=>`<div><b>${v}</b><span>${l}</span></div>`).join('');
728	  $('endOverlay').classList.add('show');
729	}
730	
731	/* ---------------- combat ---------------- */
732	function dmgMult(){ return (1 + 0.12 * S.field.filter(u=>u&&UNIT_BY_ID[u.id].base==='MS').length) * (S.focusT>0?1.25:1); }
733	function damageEnemy(e, dmg, opts={}){
734	  if (e.dead) return;
735	  const real = dmg * (1 - e.armor);
736	  e.hp -= real;
737	  if (opts.dot) e.dots.push({ dps:opts.dot, t:opts.dotT||2 });
738	  if (opts.slow){ e.slowT = Math.max(e.slowT, opts.slowT||1.2); e.slowF = Math.max(e.slowF, opts.slow); }
739	  if (opts.stun) e.stunT = Math.max(e.stunT, opts.stun);
740	  if (opts.greed){ S.gold += opts.greed; S.goldEarned += opts.greed; }
741	  const p = pathPos(e.d);
742	  if (opts.crit || real >= 60) float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, Math.round(real), opts.crit?'#ffc93d':'#f2ead8', opts.crit?15:11);
743	  if (e.hp <= 0){
744	    e.dead = true;
745	    S.kills++; S.gold += e.gold; S.goldEarned += e.gold;
746	    onKillReward(e, p);
747	    burst(p.x, p.y, e.color, e.boss?30:8);
748	    if (e.boss){ S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, 9); ringFx(p.x,p.y,e.color,80); log(`Boss destroyed! +◈${e.gold}`, 'good'); }
749	    AudioFX.kill();
750	    bump($('stGold').parentElement);
751	    syncStats();
752	  } else AudioFX.hit();
753	}
754	function enemiesInRange(x,y,r){
755	  const out=[];
756	  for (const e of S.enemies){
757	    if (e.dead) continue;
758	    const p=pathPos(e.d);
759	    if ((p.x-x)**2+(p.y-y)**2 <= r*r) out.push({e,p});
760	  }
761	  return out;
762	}
763	function unitAttack(u, def, x, y){
764	  const inR = enemiesInRange(x,y,def.range);
765	  if (!inR.length) return false;
766	  inR.sort((a,b)=>b.e.d-a.e.d);
767	  const first = (S.focusT>0 && inR.find(o=>o.e.uid===S.focusUid)) || inR[0];
768	  const mult = dmgMult();
769	  const g = GRADES[def.grade];
770	  AudioFX.shoot();
771	  const fire = (target, dmg, extra={}) => {
772	    S.projectiles.push({ uid:uidSeq++, x, y, t:target.e, tx:target.p.x, ty:target.p.y, sp:460, dmg, color:g.color, def, ...extra });
773	  };
774	  switch (def.kind){
775	    case 'single': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {greed:def.greed}); break;
776	    case 'crit': {
777	      const crit = Math.random() < (def.critC||0.25);
778	      fire(first, def.dmg*mult*(crit?(def.critX||2):1), {crit, greed:def.greed});
779	      break;
780	    }
781	    case 'slow': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {slow:def.slow, slowT:def.slowT, aoe:def.aoe}); break;
782	    case 'stun': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, stunC:def.stunC, stunT:def.stunT}); break;
783	    case 'aoe': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe||40}); break;
784	    case 'burn': case 'poison': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe||40, dot:def.dot, dotT:def.dotT}); break;
785	    case 'pierce': {
786	      const targets = [first, ...inR.slice(1).filter(o=>(o.p.x-first.p.x)**2+(o.p.y-first.p.y)**2<95*95).slice(0,(def.pierce||2)-1)];
787	      targets.forEach(t=>fire(t, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, fast:true}));
788	      break;
789	    }
790	    case 'multi': {
791	      const n = def.multi||2;
792	      for (let i=0;i<n;i++) fire(inR[i%inR.length], def.dmg*mult, {dot:def.dot, dotT:def.dotT});
793	      break;
794	    }
795	    case 'chain': {
796	      let cur = first; const hit=new Set(); const pts=[{x,y}];

837	    S.enemies.forEach(e=>{

841	    });

843	  } else if (pr.t && !pr.t.dead) hitOne(pr.t);
844	  burst(pr.tx, pr.ty, pr.color, 3);
