103	const FSAVE_KEY = 'aerd_factions_v1';
104	const GRADE_FROM_VAL = ['E','D','C','B','A','S','EX','STAR'];
105	let factionSave = loadFactionSave();
106	function loadFactionSave(){
107	  const base = { cur:'aurel', fac:{} };
108	  FACTIONS.forEach(f=>base.fac[f.key]={lv:1,xp:0});
109	  try{
110	    const raw = localStorage.getItem(FSAVE_KEY);
111	    if (raw){
112	      const p = JSON.parse(raw);
113	      if (p && p.fac){
114	        if (FACTION_BY_KEY[p.cur]) base.cur = p.cur;
115	        FACTIONS.forEach(f=>{
116	          const s = p.fac[f.key];
117	          if (s && typeof s.lv==='number') base.fac[f.key]={ lv:Math.min(FACTION_MAX_LEVEL,Math.max(1,s.lv|0)), xp:Math.max(0,s.xp|0) };
118	        });
119	      }
120	    }
121	  }catch(e){}
122	  return base;
123	}
124	function persistFactionSave(){ try{ localStorage.setItem(FSAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(factionSave)); }catch(e){} }
125	const curFaction = () => FACTION_BY_KEY[(S.mode !== 'menu' && S.factionKey) || factionSave.cur];
126	const facLevel = () => factionSave.fac[curFaction().key].lv;
127	const facMul = () => 1 + (facLevel()-1)*0.05;
128	const facMastered = () => facLevel() >= FACTION_MAX_LEVEL;
129	function addFactionXp(amount){
130	  const st = factionSave.fac[curFaction().key];
131	  if (st.lv >= FACTION_MAX_LEVEL) return;
132	  st.xp += Math.round(amount);
133	  let leveled = false;
134	  while (st.lv < FACTION_MAX_LEVEL && st.xp >= FACTION_XP_REQ[st.lv-1]){ st.xp -= FACTION_XP_REQ[st.lv-1]; st.lv++; leveled=true; }
135	  if (st.lv >= FACTION_MAX_LEVEL) st.xp = 0;
136	  persistFactionSave();
137	  if (leveled){
138	    AudioFX.ascend();
139	    toast(`⚑ ${curFaction().name} Lv${st.lv}${facMastered()?' — MASTERED!':''}`);
140	    log(`⚑ Faction rank up → ${curFaction().name} Lv${st.lv}`, 'epic');
141	  }
142	  syncFaction();
143	}
144	function setFaction(key){
145	  if (!FACTION_BY_KEY[key]) return false;
146	  if (S.mode !== 'menu' && S.mode !== 'lobby'){
147	    toast('Faction is locked for this run.', true);
148	    return false;
149	  }
150	  if (factionSave.cur === key) return true;
151	  factionSave.cur = key; persistFactionSave();
152	  AudioFX.click();
153	  log(`⚑ Sworn to ${curFaction().name} [${curFaction().tag}]`, 'good');
154	  toast(`⚑ ${curFaction().name}`);
155	  syncFaction(); syncStats();
156	  return true;
157	}
158	function onKillReward(e, p){
159	  const f = curFaction();
160	  addFactionXp(f.key==='mooncell' ? 150 : 100);
161	  if (f.key==='aurel' && Math.random()<0.5){
162	    const amt = Math.round(rand(1,15)*facMul());
163	    S.gold += amt; S.goldEarned += amt;
164	    float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, `+${amt}`, '#ffd23d', 11);
165	  }
166	  if (f.key==='steppe' && Math.random()<0.01*facMul()){
167	    S.wisps += 1;
168	    float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, '+❋', '#d0d0d0', 12);
169	    log('❋ Spirit plunder → +1 wisp', 'good');
170	  }
171	}
172	function factionActive(){
173	  if (S.mode!=='play') return;
174	  const f = curFaction();
175	  if (f.activeType==='supergold'){
176	    if (S.facCd.super>0) return;
177	    if (S.gold < f.cost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);
178	    S.gold -= f.cost; S.facCd.super=f.cd;
179	    const amt=Math.floor(rand(0,25001));
180	    S.gold += amt; S.goldEarned += amt;
181	    amt<f.cost?AudioFX.err():AudioFX.summon(amt>=20000?'S':'A');
182	    log(`◈ Imperial Privilege paid ◈${amt} (cost ◈${f.cost})`, amt<f.cost?'bad':amt>=10000?'epic':'gold');
183	    toast(amt<f.cost?`Lost ◈${f.cost-amt}…`:amt===f.cost?'Broke even!':`Won ◈${amt-f.cost}!`);
184	    if (amt>=20000) banner('◈ JACKPOT ◈');
185	    bump($('stGold').parentElement); syncStats();
186	  } else if (f.activeType==='pickup'){
187	    openPickup();
188	  } else if (f.key==='steppe'){
189	    if (S.facCd.seal>0) return;
190	    S.facCd.seal = f.cd;
191	    let n=0;
192	    S.enemies.forEach(e=>{ if(!e.dead){ e.stunT=Math.max(e.stunT,2.5); e.sealed=true; e.armor=0; e.regen=0; n++; } });
193	    AudioFX.boss(); S.shake=Math.max(S.shake,6);
194	    toast(`❋ Meteor Seal — ${n} enemies sealed`);
195	    log(`❋ Meteor Seal stunned + sealed ${n} enemies`, 'good');
196	    syncStats();
197	  } else if (f.key==='echo'){
198	    if (S.facCd.focus>0) return;
199	    S.facCd.focus = f.cd; S.focusT = 6;
200	    const front = S.enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead).sort((a,b)=>b.d-a.d)[0];
201	    S.focusUid = front ? front.uid : null;
202	    AudioFX.wave();
203	    toast('⧉ Fix Target — focus fire!');
204	    log('⧉ Fix Target locked for 6s (+25% dmg)', 'good');
205	    syncStats();
206	  } else if (f.activeType==='fusion'){
207	    doFusion();
208	  }
209	}
210	function doFusion(){
211	  if (!S.bench.includes(null)) return toast('Bench is full!', true);
212	  const pool = allUnits();
213	  for (let gv=5; gv>=1; gv--){
214	    const grade = GRADE_FROM_VAL[gv-1];
215	    const members = pool.filter(x=>gradeVal(UNIT_BY_ID[x.u.id].grade)===gv);
216	    if (members.length >= FUSION_COUNT){
217	      members.sort((a,b)=>(a.loc==='bench'?0:1)-(b.loc==='bench'?0:1));
218	      members.slice(0,FUSION_COUNT).forEach(m=>{
219	        const arr = m.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
220	        arr[m.idx]=null;
221	      });
222	      const next = GRADE_FROM_VAL[gv];
223	      giveServant(next, '⬢ Fusion');
224	      AudioFX.ascend(); banner('⬢ FUSION ⬢');
225	      log(`⬢ Fused ${FUSION_COUNT}×[${grade}] → [${next}]`, 'epic');
226	      select(null); syncStats();
227	      return;
228	    }
229	  }
230	  toast(`Need ${FUSION_COUNT} equal-grade servants (E–A) to fuse.`, true);
231	}

239	function buildPickup(){
240	  const tabs = $('pickupTabs'); tabs.innerHTML='';
241	  ['E','D','C','B'].forEach(g=>{
242	    const b=document.createElement('button');
243	    b.className = 'pkTab'+(g===pickupGrade?' sel':'');
244	    b.style.color = GRADES[g].color;
245	    b.innerHTML = `[${g}] <span class="cost">❋${PICKUP_REQ[g]}</span>`;
246	    b.onclick=()=>{ pickupGrade=g; AudioFX.click(); buildPickup(); };
247	    tabs.appendChild(b);
248	  });
249	  const grid = $('pickupGrid'); grid.innerHTML='';
250	  const need = PICKUP_REQ[pickupGrade];
251	  UNITS.filter(u=>u.grade===pickupGrade && GACHA_POOL[pickupGrade].includes(u.id)).forEach(u=>{
252	    const c=document.createElement('button');
253	    c.className='pkCard'; c.style.borderColor=GRADES[u.grade].color;
254	    c.disabled = S.wisps<need || !S.bench.includes(null);
255	    c.innerHTML=`<img src="${portraitSVG(u)}" style="border-color:${GRADES[u.grade].color}" alt="">
256	      <b>${u.name}</b><span>${u.cls} · ⛨${u.pop}</span>`;
257	    c.onclick=()=>{
258	      if (S.wisps<need) return toast('Not enough wisps!', true);
259	      if (!S.bench.includes(null)) return toast('Bench is full!', true);
260	      S.wisps-=need; S.summons++;
261	      const idx=S.bench.indexOf(null);
262	      S.bench[idx]={uid:uidSeq++, id:u.id, cd:0};
263	      AudioFX.summon(u.grade);
264	      log(`✧ Pickup [${u.grade}] ${u.name} (−❋${need})`, 'good');
265	      renderBench(idx); syncStats(); syncFaction();
266	      $('pickupOverlay').classList.remove('show');
267	    };
268	    grid.appendChild(c);
269	  });
270	  $('pickupHint').textContent = `Spend ❋${need} wisps to summon the chosen [${pickupGrade}] servant. You have ❋${S.wisps}.`;
271	}

273	/* ---------------- gambling ---------------- */
274	let gambleTab = 'gold';
275	let servantSpecial = false;
276	function buildGambling(){
277	  const goldGrid=$('goldGambleGrid'); goldGrid.innerHTML='';
278	  GOLD_GAMBLES.forEach(g=>{
279	    const b=document.createElement('button');
280	    b.className='gambleBtn'; b.id='gamble_'+g.key;

282	    b.onclick=()=>doGoldGamble(g.key);

285	  buildServantGambles();

287	function buildServantGambles(){
288	  const grid=$('servantGambleGrid'); grid.innerHTML='';
289	  SERVANT_GAMBLES.forEach(g=>{
290	    const chance=servantSpecial?g.special:g.chance;
291	    const b=document.createElement('button');
292	    b.className='gambleBtn'; b.id='servant_'+g.key;
293	    b.style.borderColor=GRADES[g.grades[g.grades.length-1]].color;
294	    b.innerHTML=`<b>[${g.label}] Servant</b><span>◈${g.cost}${g.spirit?` + ✧${g.spirit}`:''}</span><em>${chance}% success</em>`;
295	    b.onclick=()=>doServantGamble(g.key);
296	    grid.appendChild(b);
297	  });
298	  $('servantModeNormal').classList.toggle('sel',!servantSpecial);
299	  $('servantModeSpecial').classList.toggle('sel',servantSpecial);

301	function syncGambling(){
302	  if (!$('goldGambleGrid')) return;
303	  $('tabGoldGamble').classList.toggle('sel',gambleTab==='gold');
304	  $('tabServantGamble').classList.toggle('sel',gambleTab==='servant');
305	  $('goldGamble').style.display=gambleTab==='gold'?'block':'none';
306	  $('servantGamble').style.display=gambleTab==='servant'?'block':'none';
307	  GOLD_GAMBLES.forEach(g=>{
308	    const st=S.gambleStocks[g.key], b=$('gamble_'+g.key);
309	    b.disabled=S.mode!=='play'||S.gold<g.cost||st.n<1;
310	    $('stock_'+g.key).textContent=`${st.n}/${g.charges} charges${st.n<g.charges?` · next ${Math.ceil(g.cd-st.t)}s`:''}`;
311	  });
312	  SERVANT_GAMBLES.forEach(g=>{
313	    const b=$('servant_'+g.key);
314	    b.disabled=S.mode!=='play'||S.gold<g.cost||S.spirit<g.spirit||!S.bench.includes(null);
315	  });
316	}
317	function doGoldGamble(key){
318	  const g=GOLD_GAMBLES.find(x=>x.key===key);
319	  if (S.mode!=='play'||!g) return;
320	  const st=S.gambleStocks[key];
321	  if (st.n<1) return toast('No charges — wait for recharge!', true);
322	  if (S.gold<g.cost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);
323	  st.n--; S.gold-=g.cost;
324	  if (g.type==='gold'){
325	    const amt=Math.floor(rand(0,g.payout+1));
326	    S.gold+=amt; S.goldEarned+=amt;
327	    const outcome=amt<g.cost?'lost':amt===g.cost?'same':'won';
328	    log(`◈ ${g.label} paid ◈${amt} — ${outcome}`, outcome==='lost'?'bad':'gold');
329	    toast(outcome==='lost'?`◈${amt}… What a loss!`:outcome==='same'?'Broke even!':`◈${amt} obtained!`);
330	    outcome==='lost'?AudioFX.err():AudioFX.sell();
331	  } else {
332	    const amt=Math.random()<0.25?Math.floor(rand(1,4)):0;
333	    S.spirit+=amt;
334	    log(`✧ Spirit Gamble → ${amt} spirit`, amt?'good':'bad');
335	    toast(amt?`✧ +${amt} spirit`:'No spirit…');
336	    amt?AudioFX.summon('A'):AudioFX.err();
337	    bump($('stSpirit').parentElement);
338	  }
339	  bump($('stGold').parentElement); syncStats(); syncGambling();
340	}
341	function doServantGamble(key){
342	  const g=SERVANT_GAMBLES.find(x=>x.key===key);
343	  if (S.mode!=='play'||!g) return;
344	  if (!S.bench.includes(null)) return toast('Bench is full!', true);
345	  if (S.gold<g.cost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);
346	  if (S.spirit<g.spirit) return toast('Not enough spirit!', true);
347	  S.gold-=g.cost; S.spirit-=g.spirit;
348	  const chance=servantSpecial?g.special:g.chance;
349	  if (Math.random()*100<chance){
350	    S.summons++;
351	    giveServant(pick(g.grades), `♦ ${servantSpecial?'Special ':''}Servant Gambling`);
352	    banner('♦ SERVANT WON ♦');
353	  } else {
354	    AudioFX.err();
355	    log(`♦ [${g.label}] Servant Gambling failed (${chance}%)`, 'bad');
356	    toast('Servant Gambling failure…', true);
357	  }
358	  bump($('stGold').parentElement); syncStats(); syncGambling();
359	}

361	/* ---------------- logging / toast ---------------- */
362	function log(msg, cls=''){
363	  const el = document.createElement('div');
364	  el.textContent = msg; if (cls) el.className = cls;
365	  const box = $('log');
366	  box.prepend(el);
367	  while (box.children.length > 30) box.lastChild.remove();
368	}
369	let toastT = null;
370	function toast(msg, err=false){
371	  const t = $('toast');
372	  t.textContent = msg; t.className = 'show' + (err?' err':'');
373	  clearTimeout(toastT);
374	  toastT = setTimeout(()=>t.className='', 1900);
375	  if (err) AudioFX.err();
376	}

378	  const b = $('waveBanner');

380	  void b.offsetWidth; b.classList.add('show');
381	}

383	/* ---------------- stats / bench / selection UI ---------------- */
384	function bump(el){ el.classList.remove('bump'); void el.offsetWidth; el.classList.add('bump'); }
385	function buildFactionChips(){
386	  const box=$('facChips'); box.innerHTML='';
387	  const startRow=$('startFactionRow'); startRow.innerHTML='';
388	  FACTIONS.forEach(f=>{
389	    const b=document.createElement('button');
390	    b.className='facChip'; b.dataset.k=f.key; b.style.color=f.color; b.title=f.name;
391	    b.innerHTML=`<i>${f.icon}</i><b>${f.tag}</b>`;

393	    box.appendChild(b);

395	    choice.className='facChoice'; choice.dataset.k=f.key; choice.style.color=f.color;
396	    choice.innerHTML=`<i>${f.icon}</i><b>${f.tag}</b><span>${f.name}</span>`;
397	    choice.onclick=()=>setFaction(f.key);
398	    startRow.appendChild(choice);

401	function syncFaction(){
402	  const f=curFaction(), lv=facLevel(), st=factionSave.fac[f.key];
403	  const locked = S.mode !== 'menu' && S.mode !== 'lobby';
404	  for (const c of [...$('facChips').children, ...$('startFactionRow').children]){
405	    const on=c.dataset.k===f.key;
406	    c.classList.toggle('sel',on);
407	    c.style.borderColor=on?f.color:'';
408	    c.style.background=on?f.color+'22':'';
409	    c.disabled=locked;
410	    c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on?'true':'false');
411	  }
412	  $('factionPanel').classList.toggle('locked', locked);
413	  $('facLockNote').textContent = locked ? 'Locked for this run' : 'Choose before the run begins';
414	  $('startFactionDesc').textContent = `${f.passive} Active: ${f.activeName} — ${f.activeDesc}`;
415	  $('facName').textContent=f.name; $('facName').style.color=f.color;
416	  $('facTag').textContent=f.tag; $('facTag').style.background=f.color;
417	  $('facLv').textContent = facMastered()?'★ MASTER':'Lv'+lv;
418	  const req = lv>=FACTION_MAX_LEVEL?0:FACTION_XP_REQ[lv-1];
419	  $('facXpBar').style.width = (lv>=FACTION_MAX_LEVEL?100:Math.min(100,st.xp/req*100))+'%';
420	  $('facXpBar').style.background=f.color;
421	  $('facXpTxt').textContent = lv>=FACTION_MAX_LEVEL?'Mastered':`${st.xp} / ${req} XP`;
422	  $('facPassive').textContent=f.passive;
423	  const btn=$('facActiveBtn');
424	  btn.style.borderColor=f.color; btn.style.color=f.color;
425	  let sub='', dis=S.mode!=='play';
426	  if (f.activeType==='supergold'){ sub=S.facCd.super>0?`${Math.ceil(S.facCd.super)}s`:`◈${f.cost}`; dis=dis||S.facCd.super>0||S.gold<f.cost; }
427	  else if (f.activeType==='pickup'){ sub='❋ choose'; dis=dis||S.wisps<1||!S.bench.includes(null); }
428	  else if (f.activeType==='fusion'){ sub=`${FUSION_COUNT}× same grade`; }
429	  else if (f.key==='steppe'){ sub=S.facCd.seal>0?`${Math.ceil(S.facCd.seal)}s`:`${f.cd}s CD`; dis=dis||S.facCd.seal>0; }
430	  else if (f.key==='echo'){ sub=S.facCd.focus>0?`${Math.ceil(S.facCd.focus)}s`:`${f.cd}s CD`; dis=dis||S.facCd.focus>0; }
431	  btn.disabled=dis;
432	  btn.innerHTML=`${f.icon} ${f.activeName} <span class="cost">${sub}</span>`;
433	  $('facActiveDesc').textContent=f.activeDesc;
434	}
435	function syncStats(){
436	  $('stGold').textContent = Math.floor(S.gold);
437	  $('stSpirit').textContent = Math.floor(S.spirit);
438	  $('stWisps').textContent = S.wisps;
439	  $('stLives').textContent = S.lives;
440	  $('stWave').textContent = `${S.wave} / ${S.diff.waves}`;

451	  else { const c=CFG.gachaUpCost(S.gachaLv); up.disabled=S.mode!=='play'||S.spirit<c; up.innerHTML=`▲ Upgrade Gacha <span class="cost">✧ ${c}</span>`; }
452	  $('wispGold').disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1;
453	  $('wispSpirit').disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1;
454	  $('wispGacha').disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1 || !S.bench.includes(null);

457	  wb.classList.toggle('pulse', S.mode==='play' && !S.waveActive);
458	  wb.innerHTML = S.waveActive ? `≋ Wave ${S.wave}…` : (S.wave===0?'▶ Start Wave':`▶ Wave ${S.wave+1}`);
459	  $('benchN').textContent = `${S.bench.filter(Boolean).length}/${S.benchSize}`;
460	  syncFaction(); syncGambling();

486	function recipesFor(id){ return RECIPES.map((r,i)=>({...r,ri:i})).filter(r=>r.base===id); }
487	function matStatus(recipe, baseRef){
488	  const pool = allUnits().filter(x=>!(x.loc===baseRef.loc && x.idx===baseRef.idx));
489	  const used = new Set();
490	  return recipe.mats.map(mid=>{
491	    const found = pool.find(x=>x.u.id===mid && !used.has(x.u.uid));
492	    if (found) used.add(found.u.uid);
493	    return { id:mid, have:!!found, ref:found };
494	  });
495	}
496	function renderSelected(){
497	  const none = $('selNone'), card = $('selCard');
498	  const ref = S.sel && (S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench[S.sel.idx]:S.field[S.sel.idx]);
499	  if (!ref){ none.style.display='block'; card.style.display='none'; return; }
500	  none.style.display='none'; card.style.display='flex';
501	  const u = UNIT_BY_ID[ref.id], g = GRADES[u.grade];
502	  $('selImg').src = portraitSVG(u); $('selImg').style.borderColor = g.color;
503	  $('selName').textContent = u.name;
504	  $('selMeta').innerHTML =
505	    `<span class="gradeChip" style="background:${g.color}">${u.grade}</span><span>${u.cls}</span><span>⛨${u.pop}</span>` +
506	    (S.sel.loc==='field'?'<span style="color:var(--success)">deployed</span>':'<span style="color:var(--info)">on bench</span>');
507	  $('ssDmg').textContent = u.dmg; $('ssRate').textContent = u.rate; $('ssRange').textContent = u.range;
508	  $('selDesc').textContent = u.desc;
509	  $('sellBtn').textContent = `Release → ❋${Math.max(1,Math.round(gradeVal(u.grade)/2))}`;
510	  $('ascendBtn').style.display='none';

514	  rbox.style.display='block';
515	  rbox.innerHTML = '<div class="rt">▲ ASCENSION PATHS</div>';
516	  recs.forEach(r=>{
517	    const res = UNIT_BY_ID[r.result];
518	    const status = matStatus(r, S.sel);
519	    const ok = status.every(m=>m.have);
520	    const popOk = S.sel.loc!=='field' || popUsed()-u.pop+res.pop <= S.popCap;
521	    const row = document.createElement('div');
522	    row.style.cssText='margin-bottom:8px';
523	    row.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:${GRADES[res.grade].color};margin-bottom:5px">→ ${res.name} <span style="color:var(--ink-faint);font-weight:400">(⛨${res.pop})</span></div>`;
524	    const chips = document.createElement('div'); chips.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px';
525	    status.forEach(m=>{
526	      const mu = UNIT_BY_ID[m.id];
527	      const c = document.createElement('div');
528	      c.className = 'matChip ' + (m.have?'have':'miss');
529	      c.innerHTML = `<img src="${portraitSVG(mu)}" style="border-color:${GRADES[mu.grade].color}">[${mu.grade}] ${mu.name}`;
530	      chips.appendChild(c);
531	    });
532	    row.appendChild(chips);
533	    const btn = document.createElement('button');
534	    btn.textContent = ok ? (popOk?'▲ ASCEND':'⛨ POP FULL') : 'MATERIALS MISSING';
535	    btn.disabled = !ok || !popOk;
536	    btn.style.cssText='width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#a62e5b,var(--gEX));border:1px solid rgba(255,61,94,.5)';
537	    btn.onclick = ()=>ascend(r.ri);
538	    row.appendChild(btn);
539	    rbox.appendChild(row);
540	  });

543	/* ---------------- summon (gacha building) ---------------- */
544	function giveServant(grade, source){
545	  const idx = S.bench.indexOf(null);
546	  if (idx===-1){ toast('Bench is full!', true); return false; }
547	  const pool = GACHA_POOL[grade];
548	  const id = pick(pool);
549	  const u = UNIT_BY_ID[id];
550	  S.bench[idx] = { uid:uidSeq++, id, cd:0 };
551	  AudioFX.summon(grade);
552	  const epic = grade==='S'||grade==='EX'||grade==='STAR';
553	  log(`${source} [${GRADES[grade].label}] ${u.name}`, epic?'epic':grade==='A'?'gold':'');
554	  if (epic) toast(`✦ ${GRADES[grade].label}-GRADE! ${u.name} answers the call!`);
555	  renderBench(idx); syncStats();
556	  if (S.sel) renderSelected();
557	  return true;
558	}
559	function summon(){
560	  if (S.mode!=='play') return;
561	  const cost = summonCost();
562	  if (S.gold < cost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);
563	  if (!S.bench.includes(null)) return toast('Bench is full!', true);
564	  S.gold -= cost; S.summons++;
565	  let lv = S.gachaLv;
566	  S.pity++;
567	  if (S.pity >= CFG.pityEvery){ lv = Math.min(CFG.gachaMaxLv, lv+1); S.pity = 0; }
568	  const grade = GACHA_GRADE[lv-1];
569	  if (grade==='S') S.pity = 0;
570	  bump($('stGold').parentElement);
571	  giveServant(grade, 'Summoned');
572	}
573	function upgradeGacha(){
574	  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.gachaLv>=CFG.gachaMaxLv) return;
575	  const c = CFG.gachaUpCost(S.gachaLv);
576	  if (S.spirit < c) return toast('Not enough spirit!', true);
577	  S.spirit -= c; S.gachaLv++;
578	  AudioFX.ascend();
579	  const g = summonGrade();
580	  log(`▲ Gacha upgraded to Lv${S.gachaLv} — now summons [${GRADES[g].label}]`, 'gold');
581	  toast(`▲ Gacha Lv${S.gachaLv}: [${GRADES[g].label}]-grade unlocked!`);
582	  bump($('stSpirit').parentElement);
583	  syncStats();
584	}

602	function wispToGacha(){
603	  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1) return;

611	/* ---------------- placement / sell / ascend ---------------- */
612	function tryPlace(x, y, playerId=LOCAL_PLAYER){
613	  if (!S.sel || S.sel.loc!=='bench') return false;
614	  const u = S.bench[S.sel.idx];
615	  if (!u) return false;
616	  const reason = placementReason(x, y, S.field);
617	  if (reason){
618	    toast({bounds:'Outside the deployment area.', gate:'Keep the gate clear.', road:'Cannot deploy on the enemy road.', 'too-close':'Too close to another servant.'}[reason], true);
619	    return false;
620	  }
621	  const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id];
622	  if (popUsed()+def.pop > S.popCap) { toast(`Population full! (${popUsed()}/${S.popCap})`, true); return false; }
623	  let idx = S.field.findIndex(v=>!v);
624	  if (idx<0) idx = S.field.length;
625	  u.x=x; u.y=y; u.owner=playerId;
626	  S.field[idx] = u; S.bench[S.sel.idx] = null;
627	  AudioFX.place();
628	  ringFx(x, y, GRADES[def.grade].color, 40);
629	  log(`Deployed ${def.name}`, 'good');
630	  select({loc:'field', idx});
631	  syncStats();
632	  return true;
633	}
634	function unitByUid(uid){

636	    const idx = arr.findIndex(u=>u && u.uid===uid);
637	    if (idx>=0) return {u:arr[idx], loc, idx};
638	  }
639	  return null;
640	}
641	function sellSelected(){
642	  if (!S.sel) return;

644	  const u = arr[S.sel.idx]; if (!u) return;
645	  const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id];

654	function ascend(ri){
655	  const r = RECIPES[ri];
656	  if (!S.sel) return;
657	  const baseArr = S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
658	  const base = baseArr[S.sel.idx];
659	  if (!base || base.id!==r.base) return;
660	  const status = matStatus(r, S.sel);
661	  if (!status.every(m=>m.have)) return toast('Materials missing!', true);
662	  const res = UNIT_BY_ID[r.result];
663	  const baseDef = UNIT_BY_ID[base.id];
664	  if (S.sel.loc==='field' && popUsed()-baseDef.pop+res.pop > S.popCap)
665	    return toast('Not enough population!', true);
666	  status.forEach(m=>{
667	    const arr = m.ref.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
668	    arr[m.ref.idx] = null;
669	  });
670	  base.id = r.result; base.cd = 0;
671	  S.ascensions++;
672	  addFactionXp(200);
673	  if (curFaction().key==='echo' && Math.random()<0.05*facMul() && S.bench.includes(null)){
674	    const idx=S.bench.indexOf(null);
675	    S.bench[idx]={uid:uidSeq++, id:r.result, cd:0};
676	    log(`⧉ Doubled output → free copy of ${res.name}`, 'epic');
677	    toast(`⧉ Echo copy: ${res.name}!`);
678	  }
679	  AudioFX.ascend();
680	  const pos = S.sel.loc==='field' ? base : null;
681	  const rc = GRADES[res.grade].color;
682	  if (pos){ ringFx(pos.x,pos.y,rc,90); ringFx(pos.x,pos.y,'#ffd23d',60); burst(pos.x,pos.y,rc,26); S.shake=Math.max(S.shake,6); }
683	  banner(res.grade==='STAR'?'★ MOON CELL AUTOMATON ★':res.grade==='EX'?'▲ EX ASCENSION ▲':'▲ ASCENSION ▲');
684	  log(`▲ ASCENDED into ${res.name}!`, 'epic');
685	  toast(`▲ ${res.name} awakens!`);
686	  renderBench(); renderSelected(); syncStats();
687	}

689	/* ---------------- waves & enemies ---------------- */
690	function buildWave(w){
691	  const q = [];
692	  const count = Math.min(30, 8 + Math.floor(w*0.55));
693	  const isBoss = w%5===0;
694	  for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
695	    let type='normal';
696	    const r=Math.random();
697	    if (w>=20 && r<0.16) type='regen';
698	    else if (w>=10 && r<0.36) type='armor';
699	    else if (w>=4 && r<0.60) type='swift';
700	    q.push(type);
701	  }
702	  if (isBoss) q.push(w%10===0?'bigboss':'boss');
703	  return q;
704	}
705	const ETYPES = {
706	  normal:{ hp:1,   sp:74,  r:9,  color:'#ff7a4d', gold:1,   leak:1 },
707	  swift: { hp:0.6, sp:120, r:7,  color:'#3de0c8', gold:1,   leak:1 },
708	  armor: { hp:1.6, sp:58,  r:10, color:'#9ab0c8', gold:1.4, leak:1, armor:0.3 },
709	  regen: { hp:1.2, sp:66,  r:9,  color:'#5dc86a', gold:1.3, leak:1, regen:0.02 },
710	  boss:  { hp:8,  sp:46,  r:17, color:'#e14dff', gold:12,  leak:5, boss:true },
711	  bigboss:{hp:16, sp:40,  r:21, color:'#ff3d5e', gold:25,  leak:8, boss:true },
712	};
713	function startWave(){
714	  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.waveActive) return;
715	  S.wave++;
716	  S.waveActive = true;
717	  S.spawnQueue = buildWave(S.wave);
718	  S.spawnT = 0.4;
719	  const boss = S.wave%5===0;
720	  banner(boss ? `⚠ WAVE ${S.wave} — BOSS ⚠` : `WAVE ${S.wave}`);
721	  boss ? AudioFX.boss() : AudioFX.wave();
722	  log(`Wave ${S.wave} incoming${boss?' — a boss approaches!':''}`, boss?'bad':'');
723	  syncStats();
724	}
725	function spawnEnemy(type){
726	  const t = ETYPES[type], w = S.wave;
727	  const finalBoss = t.boss && w===S.diff.waves;
728	  const hp = Math.round((10 + 4*w + 0.5*w*w) * t.hp * S.diff.hp * (finalBoss?1.5:1));
729	  S.enemies.push({
730	    uid:uidSeq++, type, d:0, hp, maxHp:hp, sp:t.sp*S.diff.speed*rand(0.92,1.08), r:t.r, color:t.color,
731	    gold:Math.round((3+w*0.7)*t.gold*S.diff.gold), leak:t.leak, boss:!!t.boss,
732	    armor:t.armor||0, regen:t.regen||0, slowT:0, slowF:0, stunT:0, dots:[], dead:false,
733	  });
734	}
735	function endWave(){
736	  S.waveActive = false;
737	  const interest = Math.min(60, Math.floor(S.gold*0.08));
738	  const bonus = Math.round((30 + S.wave*5) * S.diff.gold) + interest;
739	  S.gold += bonus; S.goldEarned += bonus;
740	  S.wisps += CFG.wispsPerWave;
741	  const spiritReward = curFaction().key==='kitsune' ? 2 : 1;
742	  S.spirit += spiritReward;
743	  addFactionXp(500);
744	  log(`Wave ${S.wave} cleared! +◈${bonus}${interest?` (${interest} interest)`:''} · +❋${CFG.wispsPerWave} · +✧${spiritReward}`, 'gold');
745	  bump($('stGold').parentElement);
746	  if (S.wave >= S.diff.waves) return gameOver(true);
747	  if (S.auto) S.autoT = 2.0;
748	  syncStats();
749	}
750	function gameOver(win){
751	  S.mode = win?'won':'lost';
752	  addFactionXp(win?20000:S.wave*500);
753	  win ? AudioFX.win() : AudioFX.lose();
754	  const mins = Math.floor((S.time)/60), secs = Math.floor(S.time%60);
755	  $('endTitle').textContent = win ? '✦ GRAIL SECURED ✦' : 'THE MOON CELL FALLS';
756	  $('endTitle').className = win?'win':'lose';
757	  $('endSub').textContent = win
758	    ? `All ${S.diff.waves} waves repelled on ${S.diff.name}. The simulation is yours.`
759	    : `Overrun on wave ${S.wave} (${S.diff.name}). The grail slips away…`;
760	  $('endSub').textContent += ` ⚑ ${curFaction().name} ${facMastered()?'MASTER':'Lv'+facLevel()}.`;
761	  $('endStats').innerHTML = [
762	    [S.wave, 'WAVES'], [S.kills, 'KILLS'], [S.summons, 'SUMMONS'],
763	    [S.ascensions, 'ASCENSIONS'], [Math.floor(S.goldEarned), 'GOLD EARNED'], [`${mins}:${String(secs).padStart(2,'0')}`, 'TIME'],
764	  ].map(([v,l])=>`<div><b>${v}</b><span>${l}</span></div>`).join('');
765	  $('endOverlay').classList.add('show');
766	}
767	
768	/* ---------------- combat ---------------- */
769	function dmgMult(){ return (1 + 0.12 * S.field.filter(u=>u&&UNIT_BY_ID[u.id].base==='MS').length) * (S.focusT>0?1.25:1); }
770	function damageEnemy(e, dmg, opts={}){
771	  if (e.dead) return;
772	  const real = dmg * (1 - e.armor);
773	  e.hp -= real;
774	  if (opts.dot) e.dots.push({ dps:opts.dot, t:opts.dotT||2 });
775	  if (opts.slow){ e.slowT = Math.max(e.slowT, opts.slowT||1.2); e.slowF = Math.max(e.slowF, opts.slow); }
776	  if (opts.stun) e.stunT = Math.max(e.stunT, opts.stun);
777	  if (opts.greed){ S.gold += opts.greed; S.goldEarned += opts.greed; }
778	  const p = pathPos(e.d);
779	  if (opts.crit || real >= 60) float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, Math.round(real), opts.crit?'#ffc93d':'#f2ead8', opts.crit?15:11);
780	  if (e.hp <= 0){
781	    e.dead = true;
782	    S.kills++; S.gold += e.gold; S.goldEarned += e.gold;
783	    onKillReward(e, p);
784	    burst(p.x, p.y, e.color, e.boss?30:8);
785	    if (e.boss){ S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, 9); ringFx(p.x,p.y,e.color,80); log(`Boss destroyed! +◈${e.gold}`, 'good'); }
786	    AudioFX.kill();
787	    bump($('stGold').parentElement);
788	    syncStats();
789	  } else AudioFX.hit();
790	}
791	function enemiesInRange(x,y,r){
792	  const out=[];
793	  for (const e of S.enemies){
794	    if (e.dead) continue;
795	    const p=pathPos(e.d);
796	    if ((p.x-x)**2+(p.y-y)**2 <= r*r) out.push({e,p});
797	  }
798	  return out;
799	}
800	function unitAttack(u, def, x, y){
801	  const inR = enemiesInRange(x,y,def.range);
802	  if (!inR.length) return false;
803	  inR.sort((a,b)=>b.e.d-a.e.d);
804	  const first = (S.focusT>0 && inR.find(o=>o.e.uid===S.focusUid)) || inR[0];
805	  const mult = dmgMult();
806	  const g = GRADES[def.grade];
807	  AudioFX.shoot();
808	  const fire = (target, dmg, extra={}) => {
809	    S.projectiles.push({ uid:uidSeq++, x, y, t:target.e, tx:target.p.x, ty:target.p.y, sp:460, dmg, color:g.color, def, ...extra });
810	  };
811	  switch (def.kind){
812	    case 'single': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {greed:def.greed}); break;
813	    case 'crit': {
814	      const crit = Math.random() < (def.critC||0.25);
815	      fire(first, def.dmg*mult*(crit?(def.critX||2):1), {crit, greed:def.greed});
816	      break;
817	    }
818	    case 'slow': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {slow:def.slow, slowT:def.slowT, aoe:def.aoe}); break;
819	    case 'stun': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, stunC:def.stunC, stunT:def.stunT}); break;
820	    case 'aoe': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe||40}); break;
821	    case 'burn': case 'poison': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe||40, dot:def.dot, dotT:def.dotT}); break;
822	    case 'pierce': {
823	      const targets = [first, ...inR.slice(1).filter(o=>(o.p.x-first.p.x)**2+(o.p.y-first.p.y)**2<95*95).slice(0,(def.pierce||2)-1)];
824	      targets.forEach(t=>fire(t, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, fast:true}));
825	      break;
826	    }
827	    case 'multi': {
828	      const n = def.multi||2;
829	      for (let i=0;i<n;i++) fire(inR[i%inR.length], def.dmg*mult, {dot:def.dot, dotT:def.dotT});
830	      break;
831	    }
832	    case 'chain': {
833	      let cur = first; const hit=new Set(); const pts=[{x,y}];
834	      let dmg = def.dmg*mult;
835	      for (let i=0;i<(def.chain||3);i++){
836	        if (!cur) break;
837	        hit.add(cur.e);
838	        pts.push({x:cur.p.x,y:cur.p.y});
839	        damageEnemy(cur.e, dmg, {});
840	        dmg *= 0.75;
841	        const next = S.enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead&&!hit.has(e)).map(e=>({e,p:pathPos(e.d)}))
842	          .filter(o=>(o.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(o.p.y-cur.p.y)**2<130*130)
843	          .sort((a,b)=>((a.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(a.p.y-cur.p.y)**2)-((b.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(b.p.y-cur.p.y)**2))[0];
844	        cur = next;
845	      }
846	      S.beams.push({uid:uidSeq++, pts, t:0, life:0.18, color:g.color, w:2.5, lightning:true});
847	      break;
848	    }
849	    case 'beam': {
850	      damageEnemy(first.e, def.dmg*mult, {});
851	      if (def.aoe){
852	        S.enemies.forEach(e=>{
853	          if (e.dead || e===first.e) return;
854	          const p=pathPos(e.d);
855	          if ((p.x-first.p.x)**2+(p.y-first.p.y)**2 < def.aoe*def.aoe) damageEnemy(e, def.dmg*mult*0.7, {});
856	        });
857	        ringFx(first.p.x, first.p.y, g.color, def.aoe);
858	      }
859	      S.beams.push({uid:uidSeq++, pts:[{x,y},{x:first.p.x,y:first.p.y}], t:0, life:0.16, color:g.color, w:def.aoe?5:3});
860	      burst(first.p.x, first.p.y, g.color, 5);
861	      break;
862	    }
863	  }
864	  return true;
865	}
866	function projectileImpact(pr){
867	  const hitOne = (e)=>{
868	    damageEnemy(e, pr.dmg, {
869	      crit:pr.crit, dot:pr.dot, dotT:pr.dotT, slow:pr.slow, slowT:pr.slowT,
870	      stun:(pr.stunC && Math.random()<pr.stunC)?pr.stunT:0, greed:pr.greed,
871	    });
872	  };
873	  if (pr.aoe){
874	    S.enemies.forEach(e=>{
875	      if (e.dead) return;
876	      const p=pathPos(e.d);
877	      if ((p.x-pr.tx)**2+(p.y-pr.ty)**2 <= pr.aoe*pr.aoe) hitOne(e);
878	    });
879	    ringFx(pr.tx, pr.ty, pr.color, pr.aoe);
880	  } else if (pr.t && !pr.t.dead) hitOne(pr.t);
881	  burst(pr.tx, pr.ty, pr.color, 3);
882	}

898	/* ---------------- update (driven by the 3D loop) ---------------- */
899	function update(dt){
900	  S.time += dt;
901	  if (S.facCd.seal>0) S.facCd.seal=Math.max(0,S.facCd.seal-dt);
902	  if (S.facCd.focus>0) S.facCd.focus=Math.max(0,S.facCd.focus-dt);
903	  if (S.facCd.super>0) S.facCd.super=Math.max(0,S.facCd.super-dt);
904	  for (const g of GOLD_GAMBLES){
905	    const st=S.gambleStocks[g.key];
906	    if (st.n<g.charges){
907	      st.t+=dt;
908	      if (st.t>=g.cd){ st.t-=g.cd; st.n++; }
909	    } else st.t=0;
910	  }
911	  if (S.focusT>0) S.focusT=Math.max(0,S.focusT-dt);
912	  S.facUiT=(S.facUiT||0)+dt;
913	  if (S.facUiT>0.25){ S.facUiT=0; syncFaction(); syncGambling(); }
914	  if (S.waveActive && S.spawnQueue.length){
915	    S.spawnT -= dt;
916	    if (S.spawnT <= 0){
917	      const type = S.spawnQueue.shift();
918	      spawnEnemy(type);
919	      S.spawnT = type==='boss' ? 1.6 : Math.max(0.35, 0.95 - S.wave*0.02);
920	    }
921	  }
922	  if (S.auto && !S.waveActive && S.mode==='play' && S.wave>0 && S.wave<S.diff.waves){
923	    S.autoT -= dt;
924	    if (S.autoT<=0) startWave();
925	  }
926	  for (const e of S.enemies){
927	    if (e.dead) continue;
928	    if (e.slowT>0) e.slowT-=dt;
929	    if (e.stunT>0) e.stunT-=dt;
930	    for (const d of e.dots){ d.t-=dt; if (d.t>0){ e.hp -= d.dps*dt*(1-e.armor); } }
931	    e.dots = e.dots.filter(d=>d.t>0);
932	    if (e.regen) e.hp = Math.min(e.maxHp, e.hp + e.maxHp*e.regen*dt);
933	    if (e.hp<=0){
934	      e.dead=true; S.kills++; S.gold+=e.gold; S.goldEarned+=e.gold;
935	      const p=pathPos(e.d); onKillReward(e,p); burst(p.x,p.y,'#5dc86a',6); AudioFX.kill(); syncStats();
936	      continue;
937	    }
938	    const slow = e.slowT>0 ? 1-e.slowF : 1;
939	    e.d += e.sp * slow * (e.stunT>0?0:1) * dt;
940	    if (e.d >= PATH_LEN){
941	      e.dead = true;
942	      S.lives -= e.leak;
943	      S.leakFlash = 0.5; S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, e.boss?10:5);
944	      AudioFX.leak();
945	      log(`${e.boss?'BOSS':'Enemy'} leaked! −${e.leak} ♥`, 'bad');
946	      bump($('stLives').parentElement);
947	      syncStats();
948	      if (S.lives<=0){ S.lives=0; syncStats(); return gameOver(false); }
949	    }
950	  }
951	  S.enemies = S.enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead);
952	  if (S.waveActive && !S.spawnQueue.length && !S.enemies.length) endWave();
953	  S.field.forEach((u,i)=>{
954	    if (!u) return;
955	    u.cd -= dt;
956	    if (u.cd<=0){
957	      const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id];
958	      if (unitAttack(u, def, u.x, u.y)) u.cd = 1/def.rate;
959	      else u.cd = 0.08;
960	    }
961	  });
962	  for (const pr of S.projectiles){
963	    if (pr.t && !pr.t.dead){ const p=pathPos(pr.t.d); pr.tx=p.x; pr.ty=p.y; }
964	    const dx=pr.tx-pr.x, dy=pr.ty-pr.y, dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
965	    const step=(pr.fast?640:pr.sp)*dt;
966	    if (dist<=step+4){ pr.done=true; projectileImpact(pr); }
967	    else { pr.x+=dx/dist*step; pr.y+=dy/dist*step; }
968	  }
969	  S.projectiles = S.projectiles.filter(p=>!p.done);
970	  for (const b of S.beams) b.t+=dt;
971	  S.beams = S.beams.filter(b=>b.t<b.life);
972	  for (const r of S.rings) r.t+=dt;
973	  S.rings = S.rings.filter(r=>r.t<r.life);
974	  for (const p of S.particles){ p.t+=dt; p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.vx*=0.96; p.vy*=0.96; }
975	  S.particles = S.particles.filter(p=>p.t<p.life);
976	  for (const f of S.floats){ f.t+=dt; f.y-=28*dt; }
977	  S.floats = S.floats.filter(f=>f.t<f.life);
978	  S.shake = Math.max(0, S.shake - dt*22);
979	  S.leakFlash = Math.max(0, S.leakFlash - dt);
980	}

#### Thinking

The unit `desc` is built from the kind description + extra modifiers (e.g. "(32% for 2.8×)", "(+1 gold per hit)", "(chains 2)"). These are generated. The `kind.*` dictionary keys match the base descriptions exactly:
- 'kind.crit': 'High critical strike chance for heavy burst damage.' matches desc base.
- 'kind.aoe': 'Heavy swings splash damage to nearby foes.' matches.
- etc.

So for unit desc translation, I can build it from `t('kind.'+u.kind)` + translated modifier suffix. The modifiers are: crit `(X% for Y×)`, greed `(+1 gold per hit)`, chain `(chains N)`, multi `(N targets)`, stun `(X% stun)`, pierce, slow, dot/burn. 

This is getting complex. For #26, a clean approach: add a `unitDesc(u)` helper in game.js (or data.js) that returns `t('kind.'+u.kind)` plus a translated modifier clause. And `flavor` is a proper-noun quote — keep English (it's stylistic lore). Actually flavor quotes could stay English as "original anime art" lore. The user wants UI bilingual; lore quotes staying English is acceptable but ideally translated. Given 168 units share ~46 base flavors, translating all is heavy. Let me keep flavor English (it's decorative lore) but translate the functional desc via kind + modifiers.

No — better to RECONSTRUCT from u.kind + u.critC/critX/greed/chain/multi/stunC/pierce/slow fields, which all exist on the unit. Let me write `unitDesc(u)`:

```js
function unitDesc(u){
  let s = t('kind.'+u.kind);
  if (u.critC) s += t('mod.crit',{c:Math.round(u.critC*100), x:u.critX});
  if (u.greed) s += t('mod.greed',{n:u.greed});
  if (u.chain) s += t('mod.chain',{n:u.chain});
  if (u.multi) s += t('mod.multi',{n:u.multi});
  if (u.stunC) s += t('mod.stun',{c:Math.round(u.stunC*100)});
  if (u.pierce) s += t('mod.pierce',{n:u.pierce});
  if (u.slow) s += t('mod.slow',{p:Math.round(u.slow*100)});
  return s;
}
```

284	  return s;

291	}
292	function setLang(l) {

294	  lang = l;

296	  if (typeof document !== 'undefined' && document.documentElement) document.documentElement.lang = l;
297	  applyI18n();

299	}
300	function applyI18n() {
301	  if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.querySelectorAll) return;
302	  document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el => { el.textContent = t(el.dataset.i18n); });
303	  document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-html]').forEach(el => { el.innerHTML = t(el.dataset.i18nHtml); });
304	  document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-title]').forEach(el => { el.title = t(el.dataset.i18nTitle); });
305	  document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-placeholder]').forEach(el => { el.placeholder = t(el.dataset.i18nPlaceholder); });
306	}

87	    facCd:{seal:0,focus:0,super:0}, focusT:0, focusUid:null, facUiT:0,
88	    gambleStocks:Object.fromEntries(GOLD_GAMBLES.map(g=>[g.key,{n:g.charges,t:0}])),
89	  };
90	}
91	S = freshState('practice');

93	const popUsed = () => S.field.reduce((n,u)=>n+(u?UNIT_BY_ID[u.id].pop:0),0);
94	const gradeVal = g => ({E:1,D:2,C:3,B:4,A:5,S:6,EX:7,STAR:8}[g]||1);
95	const summonGrade = () => GACHA_GRADE[Math.min(S.gachaLv,CFG.gachaMaxLv)-1];
96	const summonCost = () => GRADES[summonGrade()].gcost;
97	const allUnits = () => [
98	  ...S.bench.map((u,i)=>u&&{u,loc:'bench',idx:i}),
99	  ...S.field.map((u,i)=>u&&{loc:'field',idx:i,u}),
100	].filter(Boolean);

102	/* ---------------- factions ---------------- */
103	const FSAVE_KEY = 'aerd_factions_v1';
104	const GRADE_FROM_VAL = ['E','D','C','B','A','S','EX','STAR'];
105	let factionSave = loadFactionSave();
106	function loadFactionSave(){
107	  const base = { cur:'aurel', fac:{} };
108	  FACTIONS.forEach(f=>base.fac[f.key]={lv:1,xp:0});
109	  try{
110	    const raw = localStorage.getItem(FSAVE_KEY);
111	    if (raw){
112	      const p = JSON.parse(raw);
113	      if (p && p.fac){
114	        if (FACTION_BY_KEY[p.cur]) base.cur = p.cur;
115	        FACTIONS.forEach(f=>{
116	          const s = p.fac[f.key];
117	          if (s && typeof s.lv==='number') base.fac[f.key]={ lv:Math.min(FACTION_MAX_LEVEL,Math.max(1,s.lv|0)), xp:Math.max(0,s.xp|0) };
118	        });
119	      }
120	    }
121	  }catch(e){}
122	  return base;
123	}
124	function persistFactionSave(){ try{ localStorage.setItem(FSAVE_KEY, JSON.stringify(factionSave)); }catch(e){} }
125	const curFaction = () => FACTION_BY_KEY[(S.mode !== 'menu' && S.factionKey) || factionSave.cur];
126	const facLevel = () => factionSave.fac[curFaction().key].lv;
127	const facMul = () => 1 + (facLevel()-1)*0.05;
128	const facMastered = () => facLevel() >= FACTION_MAX_LEVEL;
129	function addFactionXp(amount){
130	  const st = factionSave.fac[curFaction().key];
131	  if (st.lv >= FACTION_MAX_LEVEL) return;
132	  st.xp += Math.round(amount);
133	  let leveled = false;
134	  while (st.lv < FACTION_MAX_LEVEL && st.xp >= FACTION_XP_REQ[st.lv-1]){ st.xp -= FACTION_XP_REQ[st.lv-1]; st.lv++; leveled=true; }
135	  if (st.lv >= FACTION_MAX_LEVEL) st.xp = 0;
136	  persistFactionSave();
137	  if (leveled){
138	    AudioFX.ascend();
139	    toast(`⚑ ${curFaction().name} Lv${st.lv}${facMastered()?' — MASTERED!':''}`);
140	    log(`⚑ Faction rank up → ${curFaction().name} Lv${st.lv}`, 'epic');
141	  }
142	  syncFaction();
143	}
144	function setFaction(key){
145	  if (!FACTION_BY_KEY[key]) return false;
146	  if (S.mode !== 'menu' && S.mode !== 'lobby'){
147	    toast('Faction is locked for this run.', true);
148	    return false;
149	  }
150	  if (factionSave.cur === key) return true;
151	  factionSave.cur = key; persistFactionSave();
152	  AudioFX.click();
153	  log(`⚑ Sworn to ${curFaction().name} [${curFaction().tag}]`, 'good');
154	  toast(`⚑ ${curFaction().name}`);
155	  syncFaction(); syncStats();
156	  return true;
157	}
158	function onKillReward(e, p){
159	  const f = curFaction();
160	  addFactionXp(f.key==='mooncell' ? 150 : 100);
161	  if (f.key==='aurel' && Math.random()<0.5){
162	    const amt = Math.round(rand(1,15)*facMul());
163	    S.gold += amt; S.goldEarned += amt;
164	    float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, `+${amt}`, '#ffd23d', 11);
165	  }
166	  if (f.key==='steppe' && Math.random()<0.01*facMul()){
167	    S.wisps += 1;
168	    float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, '+❋', '#d0d0d0', 12);
169	    log('❋ Spirit plunder → +1 wisp', 'good');
170	  }
171	}
172	function factionActive(){
173	  if (S.mode!=='play') return;
174	  const f = curFaction();
175	  if (f.activeType==='supergold'){
176	    if (S.facCd.super>0) return;
177	    if (S.gold < f.cost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);
178	    S.gold -= f.cost; S.facCd.super=f.cd;
179	    const amt=Math.floor(rand(0,25001));
180	    S.gold += amt; S.goldEarned += amt;
181	    amt<f.cost?AudioFX.err():AudioFX.summon(amt>=20000?'S':'A');
182	    log(`◈ Imperial Privilege paid ◈${amt} (cost ◈${f.cost})`, amt<f.cost?'bad':amt>=10000?'epic':'gold');
183	    toast(amt<f.cost?`Lost ◈${f.cost-amt}…`:amt===f.cost?'Broke even!':`Won ◈${amt-f.cost}!`);
184	    if (amt>=20000) banner('◈ JACKPOT ◈');
185	    bump($('stGold').parentElement); syncStats();
186	  } else if (f.activeType==='pickup'){
187	    openPickup();
188	  } else if (f.key==='steppe'){
189	    if (S.facCd.seal>0) return;
190	    S.facCd.seal = f.cd;
191	    let n=0;
192	    S.enemies.forEach(e=>{ if(!e.dead){ e.stunT=Math.max(e.stunT,2.5); e.sealed=true; e.armor=0; e.regen=0; n++; } });
193	    AudioFX.boss(); S.shake=Math.max(S.shake,6);
194	    toast(`❋ Meteor Seal — ${n} enemies sealed`);
195	    log(`❋ Meteor Seal stunned + sealed ${n} enemies`, 'good');
196	    syncStats();
197	  } else if (f.key==='echo'){
198	    if (S.facCd.focus>0) return;
199	    S.facCd.focus = f.cd; S.focusT = 6;
200	    const front = S.enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead).sort((a,b)=>b.d-a.d)[0];
201	    S.focusUid = front ? front.uid : null;
202	    AudioFX.wave();
203	    toast('⧉ Fix Target — focus fire!');
204	    log('⧉ Fix Target locked for 6s (+25% dmg)', 'good');
205	    syncStats();
206	  } else if (f.activeType==='fusion'){
207	    doFusion();
208	  }
209	}
210	function doFusion(){
211	  if (!S.bench.includes(null)) return toast('Bench is full!', true);
212	  const pool = allUnits();
213	  for (let gv=5; gv>=1; gv--){
214	    const grade = GRADE_FROM_VAL[gv-1];
215	    const members = pool.filter(x=>gradeVal(UNIT_BY_ID[x.u.id].grade)===gv);
216	    if (members.length >= FUSION_COUNT){
217	      members.sort((a,b)=>(a.loc==='bench'?0:1)-(b.loc==='bench'?0:1));
218	      members.slice(0,FUSION_COUNT).forEach(m=>{
219	        const arr = m.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
220	        arr[m.idx]=null;
221	      });
222	      const next = GRADE_FROM_VAL[gv];
223	      giveServant(next, '⬢ Fusion');
224	      AudioFX.ascend(); banner('⬢ FUSION ⬢');
225	      log(`⬢ Fused ${FUSION_COUNT}×[${grade}] → [${next}]`, 'epic');
226	      select(null); syncStats();
227	      return;
228	    }
229	  }
230	  toast(`Need ${FUSION_COUNT} equal-grade servants (E–A) to fuse.`, true);
231	}

233	let pickupGrade = 'E';
234	function openPickup(){
235	  pickupGrade = 'E';
236	  buildPickup();
237	  $('pickupOverlay').classList.add('show');

239	function buildPickup(){
240	  const tabs = $('pickupTabs'); tabs.innerHTML='';
241	  ['E','D','C','B'].forEach(g=>{
242	    const b=document.createElement('button');
243	    b.className = 'pkTab'+(g===pickupGrade?' sel':'');
244	    b.style.color = GRADES[g].color;
245	    b.innerHTML = `[${g}] <span class="cost">❋${PICKUP_REQ[g]}</span>`;
246	    b.onclick=()=>{ pickupGrade=g; AudioFX.click(); buildPickup(); };
247	    tabs.appendChild(b);
248	  });
249	  const grid = $('pickupGrid'); grid.innerHTML='';
250	  const need = PICKUP_REQ[pickupGrade];
251	  UNITS.filter(u=>u.grade===pickupGrade && GACHA_POOL[pickupGrade].includes(u.id)).forEach(u=>{
252	    const c=document.createElement('button');
253	    c.className='pkCard'; c.style.borderColor=GRADES[u.grade].color;
254	    c.disabled = S.wisps<need || !S.bench.includes(null);
255	    c.innerHTML=`<img src="${portraitSVG(u)}" style="border-color:${GRADES[u.grade].color}" alt="">
256	      <b>${u.name}</b><span>${u.cls} · ⛨${u.pop}</span>`;
257	    c.onclick=()=>{
258	      if (S.wisps<need) return toast('Not enough wisps!', true);
259	      if (!S.bench.includes(null)) return toast('Bench is full!', true);
260	      S.wisps-=need; S.summons++;
261	      const idx=S.bench.indexOf(null);
262	      S.bench[idx]={uid:uidSeq++, id:u.id, cd:0};
263	      AudioFX.summon(u.grade);
264	      log(`✧ Pickup [${u.grade}] ${u.name} (−❋${need})`, 'good');
265	      renderBench(idx); syncStats(); syncFaction();
266	      $('pickupOverlay').classList.remove('show');
267	    };
268	    grid.appendChild(c);
269	  });
270	  $('pickupHint').textContent = `Spend ❋${need} wisps to summon the chosen [${pickupGrade}] servant. You have ❋${S.wisps}.`;
271	}

273	/* ---------------- gambling ---------------- */
274	let gambleTab = 'gold';
275	let servantSpecial = false;
276	function buildGambling(){
277	  const goldGrid=$('goldGambleGrid'); goldGrid.innerHTML='';
278	  GOLD_GAMBLES.forEach(g=>{
279	    const b=document.createElement('button');
280	    b.className='gambleBtn'; b.id='gamble_'+g.key;
281	    b.innerHTML=`<b>${g.label}</b><span>${g.type==='gold'?`◈${g.cost} → ◈0–${g.payout}`:`◈${g.cost} → 25%: ✧1–3`}</span><em id="stock_${g.key}"></em>`;
282	    b.onclick=()=>doGoldGamble(g.key);
283	    goldGrid.appendChild(b);
284	  });
285	  buildServantGambles();
286	}
287	function buildServantGambles(){
288	  const grid=$('servantGambleGrid'); grid.innerHTML='';
289	  SERVANT_GAMBLES.forEach(g=>{
290	    const chance=servantSpecial?g.special:g.chance;
291	    const b=document.createElement('button');
292	    b.className='gambleBtn'; b.id='servant_'+g.key;
293	    b.style.borderColor=GRADES[g.grades[g.grades.length-1]].color;
294	    b.innerHTML=`<b>[${g.label}] Servant</b><span>◈${g.cost}${g.spirit?` + ✧${g.spirit}`:''}</span><em>${chance}% success</em>`;
295	    b.onclick=()=>doServantGamble(g.key);
296	    grid.appendChild(b);
297	  });
298	  $('servantModeNormal').classList.toggle('sel',!servantSpecial);
299	  $('servantModeSpecial').classList.toggle('sel',servantSpecial);
300	}
301	function syncGambling(){
302	  if (!$('goldGambleGrid')) return;
303	  $('tabGoldGamble').classList.toggle('sel',gambleTab==='gold');
304	  $('tabServantGamble').classList.toggle('sel',gambleTab==='servant');
305	  $('goldGamble').style.display=gambleTab==='gold'?'block':'none';
306	  $('servantGamble').style.display=gambleTab==='servant'?'block':'none';
307	  GOLD_GAMBLES.forEach(g=>{
308	    const st=S.gambleStocks[g.key], b=$('gamble_'+g.key);
309	    b.disabled=S.mode!=='play'||S.gold<g.cost||st.n<1;
310	    $('stock_'+g.key).textContent=`${st.n}/${g.charges} charges${st.n<g.charges?` · next ${Math.ceil(g.cd-st.t)}s`:''}`;
311	  });
312	  SERVANT_GAMBLES.forEach(g=>{
313	    const b=$('servant_'+g.key);
314	    b.disabled=S.mode!=='play'||S.gold<g.cost||S.spirit<g.spirit||!S.bench.includes(null);
315	  });
316	}
317	function doGoldGamble(key){
318	  const g=GOLD_GAMBLES.find(x=>x.key===key);
319	  if (S.mode!=='play'||!g) return;
320	  const st=S.gambleStocks[key];
321	  if (st.n<1) return toast('No charges — wait for recharge!', true);
322	  if (S.gold<g.cost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);
323	  st.n--; S.gold-=g.cost;
324	  if (g.type==='gold'){
325	    const amt=Math.floor(rand(0,g.payout+1));
326	    S.gold+=amt; S.goldEarned+=amt;
327	    const outcome=amt<g.cost?'lost':amt===g.cost?'same':'won';
328	    log(`◈ ${g.label} paid ◈${amt} — ${outcome}`, outcome==='lost'?'bad':'gold');
329	    toast(outcome==='lost'?`◈${amt}… What a loss!`:outcome==='same'?'Broke even!':`◈${amt} obtained!`);
330	    outcome==='lost'?AudioFX.err():AudioFX.sell();
331	  } else {
332	    const amt=Math.random()<0.25?Math.floor(rand(1,4)):0;
333	    S.spirit+=amt;
334	    log(`✧ Spirit Gamble → ${amt} spirit`, amt?'good':'bad');
335	    toast(amt?`✧ +${amt} spirit`:'No spirit…');
336	    amt?AudioFX.summon('A'):AudioFX.err();
337	    bump($('stSpirit').parentElement);
338	  }
339	  bump($('stGold').parentElement); syncStats(); syncGambling();
340	}
341	function doServantGamble(key){
342	  const g=SERVANT_GAMBLES.find(x=>x.key===key);
343	  if (S.mode!=='play'||!g) return;
344	  if (!S.bench.includes(null)) return toast('Bench is full!', true);
345	  if (S.gold<g.cost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);
346	  if (S.spirit<g.spirit) return toast('Not enough spirit!', true);
347	  S.gold-=g.cost; S.spirit-=g.spirit;
348	  const chance=servantSpecial?g.special:g.chance;
349	  if (Math.random()*100<chance){
350	    S.summons++;
351	    giveServant(pick(g.grades), `♦ ${servantSpecial?'Special ':''}Servant Gambling`);
352	    banner('♦ SERVANT WON ♦');
353	  } else {
354	    AudioFX.err();
355	    log(`♦ [${g.label}] Servant Gambling failed (${chance}%)`, 'bad');
356	    toast('Servant Gambling failure…', true);
357	  }
358	  bump($('stGold').parentElement); syncStats(); syncGambling();
359	}

361	/* ---------------- logging / toast ---------------- */
362	function log(msg, cls=''){
363	  const el = document.createElement('div');
364	  el.textContent = msg; if (cls) el.className = cls;
365	  const box = $('log');
366	  box.prepend(el);
367	  while (box.children.length > 30) box.lastChild.remove();
368	}
369	let toastT = null;
370	function toast(msg, err=false){
371	  const t = $('toast');
372	  t.textContent = msg; t.className = 'show' + (err?' err':'');
373	  clearTimeout(toastT);
374	  toastT = setTimeout(()=>t.className='', 1900);
375	  if (err) AudioFX.err();
376	}
377	function banner(txt){
378	  const b = $('waveBanner');
379	  b.textContent = txt; b.classList.remove('show');
380	  void b.offsetWidth; b.classList.add('show');
381	}

383	/* ---------------- stats / bench / selection UI ---------------- */
384	function bump(el){ el.classList.remove('bump'); void el.offsetWidth; el.classList.add('bump'); }
385	function buildFactionChips(){
386	  const box=$('facChips'); box.innerHTML='';
387	  const startRow=$('startFactionRow'); startRow.innerHTML='';
388	  FACTIONS.forEach(f=>{
389	    const b=document.createElement('button');
390	    b.className='facChip'; b.dataset.k=f.key; b.style.color=f.color; b.title=f.name;
391	    b.innerHTML=`<i>${f.icon}</i><b>${f.tag}</b>`;
392	    b.onclick=()=>setFaction(f.key);
393	    box.appendChild(b);
394	    const choice=document.createElement('button');
395	    choice.className='facChoice'; choice.dataset.k=f.key; choice.style.color=f.color;
396	    choice.innerHTML=`<i>${f.icon}</i><b>${f.tag}</b><span>${f.name}</span>`;
397	    choice.onclick=()=>setFaction(f.key);
398	    startRow.appendChild(choice);
399	  });
400	}
401	function syncFaction(){
402	  const f=curFaction(), lv=facLevel(), st=factionSave.fac[f.key];
403	  const locked = S.mode !== 'menu' && S.mode !== 'lobby';
404	  for (const c of [...$('facChips').children, ...$('startFactionRow').children]){
405	    const on=c.dataset.k===f.key;
406	    c.classList.toggle('sel',on);
407	    c.style.borderColor=on?f.color:'';
408	    c.style.background=on?f.color+'22':'';
409	    c.disabled=locked;
410	    c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on?'true':'false');
411	  }
412	  $('factionPanel').classList.toggle('locked', locked);
413	  $('facLockNote').textContent = locked ? 'Locked for this run' : 'Choose before the run begins';
414	  $('startFactionDesc').textContent = `${f.passive} Active: ${f.activeName} — ${f.activeDesc}`;
415	  $('facName').textContent=f.name; $('facName').style.color=f.color;
416	  $('facTag').textContent=f.tag; $('facTag').style.background=f.color;
417	  $('facLv').textContent = facMastered()?'★ MASTER':'Lv'+lv;
418	  const req = lv>=FACTION_MAX_LEVEL?0:FACTION_XP_REQ[lv-1];
419	  $('facXpBar').style.width = (lv>=FACTION_MAX_LEVEL?100:Math.min(100,st.xp/req*100))+'%';
420	  $('facXpBar').style.background=f.color;
421	  $('facXpTxt').textContent = lv>=FACTION_MAX_LEVEL?'Mastered':`${st.xp} / ${req} XP`;
422	  $('facPassive').textContent=f.passive;
423	  const btn=$('facActiveBtn');
424	  btn.style.borderColor=f.color; btn.style.color=f.color;
425	  let sub='', dis=S.mode!=='play';
426	  if (f.activeType==='supergold'){ sub=S.facCd.super>0?`${Math.ceil(S.facCd.super)}s`:`◈${f.cost}`; dis=dis||S.facCd.super>0||S.gold<f.cost; }
427	  else if (f.activeType==='pickup'){ sub='❋ choose'; dis=dis||S.wisps<1||!S.bench.includes(null); }
428	  else if (f.activeType==='fusion'){ sub=`${FUSION_COUNT}× same grade`; }
429	  else if (f.key==='steppe'){ sub=S.facCd.seal>0?`${Math.ceil(S.facCd.seal)}s`:`${f.cd}s CD`; dis=dis||S.facCd.seal>0; }
430	  else if (f.key==='echo'){ sub=S.facCd.focus>0?`${Math.ceil(S.facCd.focus)}s`:`${f.cd}s CD`; dis=dis||S.facCd.focus>0; }
431	  btn.disabled=dis;
432	  btn.innerHTML=`${f.icon} ${f.activeName} <span class="cost">${sub}</span>`;
433	  $('facActiveDesc').textContent=f.activeDesc;
434	}
435	function syncStats(){
436	  $('stGold').textContent = Math.floor(S.gold);
437	  $('stSpirit').textContent = Math.floor(S.spirit);
438	  $('stWisps').textContent = S.wisps;
439	  $('stLives').textContent = S.lives;
440	  $('stWave').textContent = `${S.wave} / ${S.diff.waves}`;
441	  $('stPop').textContent = `${popUsed()} / ${S.popCap}`;
442	  const sg = summonGrade();
443	  $('gachaLv').textContent = S.gachaLv;
444	  $('gachaGrade').textContent = GRADES[sg].label;
445	  $('gachaGrade').style.color = GRADES[sg].color;
446	  $('summonCost').textContent = summonCost();
447	  $('pityN').textContent = CFG.pityEvery - S.pity;
448	  $('summonBtn').disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.gold < summonCost() || !S.bench.includes(null);
449	  const up = $('gachaUpBtn');
450	  if (S.gachaLv>=CFG.gachaMaxLv){ up.disabled=true; up.innerHTML='MAX GRADE'; }
451	  else { const c=CFG.gachaUpCost(S.gachaLv); up.disabled=S.mode!=='play'||S.spirit<c; up.innerHTML=`▲ Upgrade Gacha <span class="cost">✧ ${c}</span>`; }
452	  $('wispGold').disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1;
453	  $('wispSpirit').disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1;
454	  $('wispGacha').disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1 || !S.bench.includes(null);
455	  const wb = $('waveBtn');
456	  wb.disabled = S.mode!=='play' || S.waveActive;
457	  wb.classList.toggle('pulse', S.mode==='play' && !S.waveActive);
458	  wb.innerHTML = S.waveActive ? `≋ Wave ${S.wave}…` : (S.wave===0?'▶ Start Wave':`▶ Wave ${S.wave+1}`);
459	  $('benchN').textContent = `${S.bench.filter(Boolean).length}/${S.benchSize}`;
460	  syncFaction(); syncGambling();
461	}
462	function renderBench(newIdx=-1){
463	  const box = $('bench'); box.innerHTML='';
464	  S.bench.forEach((u,i)=>{
465	    const d = document.createElement('div');
466	    d.className = 'bslot ' + (u?'filled':'empty');
467	    if (u){
468	      const g = GRADES[UNIT_BY_ID[u.id].grade];
469	      d.style.borderColor = g.color;
470	      const img = document.createElement('img');
471	      img.src = portraitSVG(UNIT_BY_ID[u.id]); img.alt = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id].name;
472	      d.appendChild(img);
473	      const pop = document.createElement('div'); pop.className='pop'; pop.textContent=UNIT_BY_ID[u.id].pop;
474	      d.appendChild(pop);
475	      if (S.sel && S.sel.loc==='bench' && S.sel.idx===i) d.classList.add('sel');
476	      if (i===newIdx) d.classList.add('new');
477	      d.onclick = ()=>{ AudioFX.click(); select(S.sel&&S.sel.loc==='bench'&&S.sel.idx===i ? null : {loc:'bench',idx:i}); };
478	    }
479	    box.appendChild(d);
480	  });
481	}
482	function select(sel){
483	  S.sel = sel;
484	  renderBench(); renderSelected();
485	}
486	function recipesFor(id){ return RECIPES.map((r,i)=>({...r,ri:i})).filter(r=>r.base===id); }
487	function matStatus(recipe, baseRef){
488	  const pool = allUnits().filter(x=>!(x.loc===baseRef.loc && x.idx===baseRef.idx));
489	  const used = new Set();
490	  return recipe.mats.map(mid=>{
491	    const found = pool.find(x=>x.u.id===mid && !used.has(x.u.uid));
492	    if (found) used.add(found.u.uid);
493	    return { id:mid, have:!!found, ref:found };
494	  });
495	}
496	function renderSelected(){
497	  const none = $('selNone'), card = $('selCard');
498	  const ref = S.sel && (S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench[S.sel.idx]:S.field[S.sel.idx]);
499	  if (!ref){ none.style.display='block'; card.style.display='none'; return; }
500	  none.style.display='none'; card.style.display='flex';
501	  const u = UNIT_BY_ID[ref.id], g = GRADES[u.grade];
502	  $('selImg').src = portraitSVG(u); $('selImg').style.borderColor = g.color;
503	  $('selName').textContent = u.name;
504	  $('selMeta').innerHTML =
505	    `<span class="gradeChip" style="background:${g.color}">${u.grade}</span><span>${u.cls}</span><span>⛨${u.pop}</span>` +
506	    (S.sel.loc==='field'?'<span style="color:var(--success)">deployed</span>':'<span style="color:var(--info)">on bench</span>');
507	  $('ssDmg').textContent = u.dmg; $('ssRate').textContent = u.rate; $('ssRange').textContent = u.range;
508	  $('selDesc').textContent = u.desc;
509	  $('sellBtn').textContent = `Release → ❋${Math.max(1,Math.round(gradeVal(u.grade)/2))}`;
510	  $('ascendBtn').style.display='none';
511	  const rbox = $('recipeBox');
512	  const recs = recipesFor(ref.id);
513	  if (!recs.length){ rbox.style.display='none'; return; }
514	  rbox.style.display='block';
515	  rbox.innerHTML = '<div class="rt">▲ ASCENSION PATHS</div>';
516	  recs.forEach(r=>{
517	    const res = UNIT_BY_ID[r.result];
518	    const status = matStatus(r, S.sel);
519	    const ok = status.every(m=>m.have);
520	    const popOk = S.sel.loc!=='field' || popUsed()-u.pop+res.pop <= S.popCap;
521	    const row = document.createElement('div');
522	    row.style.cssText='margin-bottom:8px';
523	    row.innerHTML = `<div style="font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:${GRADES[res.grade].color};margin-bottom:5px">→ ${res.name} <span style="color:var(--ink-faint);font-weight:400">(⛨${res.pop})</span></div>`;
524	    const chips = document.createElement('div'); chips.style.cssText='display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px';
525	    status.forEach(m=>{
526	      const mu = UNIT_BY_ID[m.id];
527	      const c = document.createElement('div');
528	      c.className = 'matChip ' + (m.have?'have':'miss');
529	      c.innerHTML = `<img src="${portraitSVG(mu)}" style="border-color:${GRADES[mu.grade].color}">[${mu.grade}] ${mu.name}`;
530	      chips.appendChild(c);
531	    });
532	    row.appendChild(chips);
533	    const btn = document.createElement('button');
534	    btn.textContent = ok ? (popOk?'▲ ASCEND':'⛨ POP FULL') : 'MATERIALS MISSING';
535	    btn.disabled = !ok || !popOk;
536	    btn.style.cssText='width:100%;padding:8px;border-radius:8px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;background:linear-gradient(120deg,#a62e5b,var(--gEX));border:1px solid rgba(255,61,94,.5)';
537	    btn.onclick = ()=>ascend(r.ri);
538	    row.appendChild(btn);
539	    rbox.appendChild(row);
540	  });
541	}

543	/* ---------------- summon (gacha building) ---------------- */
544	function giveServant(grade, source){
545	  const idx = S.bench.indexOf(null);
546	  if (idx===-1){ toast('Bench is full!', true); return false; }
547	  const pool = GACHA_POOL[grade];
548	  const id = pick(pool);
549	  const u = UNIT_BY_ID[id];
550	  S.bench[idx] = { uid:uidSeq++, id, cd:0 };
551	  AudioFX.summon(grade);
552	  const epic = grade==='S'||grade==='EX'||grade==='STAR';
553	  log(`${source} [${GRADES[grade].label}] ${u.name}`, epic?'epic':grade==='A'?'gold':'');
554	  if (epic) toast(`✦ ${GRADES[grade].label}-GRADE! ${u.name} answers the call!`);
555	  renderBench(idx); syncStats();
556	  if (S.sel) renderSelected();
557	  return true;
558	}
559	function summon(){
560	  if (S.mode!=='play') return;
561	  const cost = summonCost();
562	  if (S.gold < cost) return toast('Not enough gold!', true);
563	  if (!S.bench.includes(null)) return toast('Bench is full!', true);
564	  S.gold -= cost; S.summons++;
565	  let lv = S.gachaLv;
566	  S.pity++;
567	  if (S.pity >= CFG.pityEvery){ lv = Math.min(CFG.gachaMaxLv, lv+1); S.pity = 0; }
568	  const grade = GACHA_GRADE[lv-1];
569	  if (grade==='S') S.pity = 0;
570	  bump($('stGold').parentElement);
571	  giveServant(grade, 'Summoned');
572	}
573	function upgradeGacha(){
574	  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.gachaLv>=CFG.gachaMaxLv) return;
575	  const c = CFG.gachaUpCost(S.gachaLv);
576	  if (S.spirit < c) return toast('Not enough spirit!', true);
577	  S.spirit -= c; S.gachaLv++;
578	  AudioFX.ascend();
579	  const g = summonGrade();
580	  log(`▲ Gacha upgraded to Lv${S.gachaLv} — now summons [${GRADES[g].label}]`, 'gold');
581	  toast(`▲ Gacha Lv${S.gachaLv}: [${GRADES[g].label}]-grade unlocked!`);
582	  bump($('stSpirit').parentElement);
583	  syncStats();
584	}

602	function wispToGacha(){
603	  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.wisps<1) return;

605	  S.wisps--; S.summons++;

611	/* ---------------- placement / sell / ascend ---------------- */
612	function tryPlace(x, y, playerId=LOCAL_PLAYER){
613	  if (!S.sel || S.sel.loc!=='bench') return false;
614	  const u = S.bench[S.sel.idx];
615	  if (!u) return false;
616	  const reason = placementReason(x, y, S.field);
617	  if (reason){
618	    toast({bounds:'Outside the deployment area.', gate:'Keep the gate clear.', road:'Cannot deploy on the enemy road.', 'too-close':'Too close to another servant.'}[reason], true);
619	    return false;
620	  }
621	  const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id];
622	  if (popUsed()+def.pop > S.popCap) { toast(`Population full! (${popUsed()}/${S.popCap})`, true); return false; }
623	  let idx = S.field.findIndex(v=>!v);
624	  if (idx<0) idx = S.field.length;
625	  u.x=x; u.y=y; u.owner=playerId;
626	  S.field[idx] = u; S.bench[S.sel.idx] = null;
627	  AudioFX.place();
628	  ringFx(x, y, GRADES[def.grade].color, 40);
629	  log(`Deployed ${def.name}`, 'good');
630	  select({loc:'field', idx});
631	  syncStats();
632	  return true;
633	}
634	function unitByUid(uid){
635	  for (const [loc,arr] of [['bench',S.bench],['field',S.field]]){
636	    const idx = arr.findIndex(u=>u && u.uid===uid);
637	    if (idx>=0) return {u:arr[idx], loc, idx};
638	  }
639	  return null;
640	}
641	function sellSelected(){
642	  if (!S.sel) return;
643	  const arr = S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
644	  const u = arr[S.sel.idx]; if (!u) return;
645	  const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id];
646	  const w = Math.max(1, Math.round(gradeVal(def.grade)/2));
647	  S.wisps += w;
648	  arr[S.sel.idx] = null;
649	  AudioFX.sell();
650	  log(`Released ${def.name} → ❋${w} wisp${w>1?'s':''}`, 'good');
651	  toast(`❋ +${w} wisp${w>1?'s':''}`);
652	  select(null); syncStats();
653	}
654	function ascend(ri){
655	  const r = RECIPES[ri];
656	  if (!S.sel) return;
657	  const baseArr = S.sel.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
658	  const base = baseArr[S.sel.idx];
659	  if (!base || base.id!==r.base) return;
660	  const status = matStatus(r, S.sel);
661	  if (!status.every(m=>m.have)) return toast('Materials missing!', true);
662	  const res = UNIT_BY_ID[r.result];
663	  const baseDef = UNIT_BY_ID[base.id];
664	  if (S.sel.loc==='field' && popUsed()-baseDef.pop+res.pop > S.popCap)
665	    return toast('Not enough population!', true);
666	  status.forEach(m=>{
667	    const arr = m.ref.loc==='bench'?S.bench:S.field;
668	    arr[m.ref.idx] = null;
669	  });
670	  base.id = r.result; base.cd = 0;
671	  S.ascensions++;
672	  addFactionXp(200);
673	  if (curFaction().key==='echo' && Math.random()<0.05*facMul() && S.bench.includes(null)){
674	    const idx=S.bench.indexOf(null);
675	    S.bench[idx]={uid:uidSeq++, id:r.result, cd:0};
676	    log(`⧉ Doubled output → free copy of ${res.name}`, 'epic');
677	    toast(`⧉ Echo copy: ${res.name}!`);
678	  }
679	  AudioFX.ascend();
680	  const pos = S.sel.loc==='field' ? base : null;
681	  const rc = GRADES[res.grade].color;
682	  if (pos){ ringFx(pos.x,pos.y,rc,90); ringFx(pos.x,pos.y,'#ffd23d',60); burst(pos.x,pos.y,rc,26); S.shake=Math.max(S.shake,6); }
683	  banner(res.grade==='STAR'?'★ MOON CELL AUTOMATON ★':res.grade==='EX'?'▲ EX ASCENSION ▲':'▲ ASCENSION ▲');
684	  log(`▲ ASCENDED into ${res.name}!`, 'epic');
685	  toast(`▲ ${res.name} awakens!`);
686	  renderBench(); renderSelected(); syncStats();
687	}

689	/* ---------------- waves & enemies ---------------- */
690	function buildWave(w){
691	  const q = [];
692	  const count = Math.min(30, 8 + Math.floor(w*0.55));
693	  const isBoss = w%5===0;
694	  for (let i=0;i<count;i++){
695	    let type='normal';
696	    const r=Math.random();
697	    if (w>=20 && r<0.16) type='regen';
698	    else if (w>=10 && r<0.36) type='armor';
699	    else if (w>=4 && r<0.60) type='swift';
700	    q.push(type);
701	  }
702	  if (isBoss) q.push(w%10===0?'bigboss':'boss');
703	  return q;
704	}
705	const ETYPES = {
706	  normal:{ hp:1,   sp:74,  r:9,  color:'#ff7a4d', gold:1,   leak:1 },
707	  swift: { hp:0.6, sp:120, r:7,  color:'#3de0c8', gold:1,   leak:1 },
708	  armor: { hp:1.6, sp:58,  r:10, color:'#9ab0c8', gold:1.4, leak:1, armor:0.3 },
709	  regen: { hp:1.2, sp:66,  r:9,  color:'#5dc86a', gold:1.3, leak:1, regen:0.02 },
710	  boss:  { hp:8,  sp:46,  r:17, color:'#e14dff', gold:12,  leak:5, boss:true },
711	  bigboss:{hp:16, sp:40,  r:21, color:'#ff3d5e', gold:25,  leak:8, boss:true },
712	};
713	function startWave(){
714	  if (S.mode!=='play' || S.waveActive) return;
715	  S.wave++;
716	  S.waveActive = true;
717	  S.spawnQueue = buildWave(S.wave);
718	  S.spawnT = 0.4;
719	  const boss = S.wave%5===0;
720	  banner(boss ? `⚠ WAVE ${S.wave} — BOSS ⚠` : `WAVE ${S.wave}`);
721	  boss ? AudioFX.boss() : AudioFX.wave();
722	  log(`Wave ${S.wave} incoming${boss?' — a boss approaches!':''}`, boss?'bad':'');
723	  syncStats();
724	}
725	function spawnEnemy(type){
726	  const t = ETYPES[type], w = S.wave;
727	  const finalBoss = t.boss && w===S.diff.waves;
728	  const hp = Math.round((10 + 4*w + 0.5*w*w) * t.hp * S.diff.hp * (finalBoss?1.5:1));
729	  S.enemies.push({
730	    uid:uidSeq++, type, d:0, hp, maxHp:hp, sp:t.sp*S.diff.speed*rand(0.92,1.08), r:t.r, color:t.color,
731	    gold:Math.round((3+w*0.7)*t.gold*S.diff.gold), leak:t.leak, boss:!!t.boss,
732	    armor:t.armor||0, regen:t.regen||0, slowT:0, slowF:0, stunT:0, dots:[], dead:false,
733	  });
734	}
735	function endWave(){
736	  S.waveActive = false;
737	  const interest = Math.min(60, Math.floor(S.gold*0.08));
738	  const bonus = Math.round((30 + S.wave*5) * S.diff.gold) + interest;
739	  S.gold += bonus; S.goldEarned += bonus;
740	  S.wisps += CFG.wispsPerWave;
741	  const spiritReward = curFaction().key==='kitsune' ? 2 : 1;
742	  S.spirit += spiritReward;
743	  addFactionXp(500);
744	  log(`Wave ${S.wave} cleared! +◈${bonus}${interest?` (${interest} interest)`:''} · +❋${CFG.wispsPerWave} · +✧${spiritReward}`, 'gold');
745	  bump($('stGold').parentElement);
746	  if (S.wave >= S.diff.waves) return gameOver(true);
747	  if (S.auto) S.autoT = 2.0;
748	  syncStats();
749	}
750	function gameOver(win){
751	  S.mode = win?'won':'lost';
752	  addFactionXp(win?20000:S.wave*500);
753	  win ? AudioFX.win() : AudioFX.lose();
754	  const mins = Math.floor((S.time)/60), secs = Math.floor(S.time%60);
755	  $('endTitle').textContent = win ? '✦ GRAIL SECURED ✦' : 'THE MOON CELL FALLS';
756	  $('endTitle').className = win?'win':'lose';
757	  $('endSub').textContent = win
758	    ? `All ${S.diff.waves} waves repelled on ${S.diff.name}. The simulation is yours.`
759	    : `Overrun on wave ${S.wave} (${S.diff.name}). The grail slips away…`;
760	  $('endSub').textContent += ` ⚑ ${curFaction().name} ${facMastered()?'MASTER':'Lv'+facLevel()}.`;
761	  $('endStats').innerHTML = [
762	    [S.wave, 'WAVES'], [S.kills, 'KILLS'], [S.summons, 'SUMMONS'],
763	    [S.ascensions, 'ASCENSIONS'], [Math.floor(S.goldEarned), 'GOLD EARNED'], [`${mins}:${String(secs).padStart(2,'0')}`, 'TIME'],
764	  ].map(([v,l])=>`<div><b>${v}</b><span>${l}</span></div>`).join('');
765	  $('endOverlay').classList.add('show');
766	}
767	
768	/* ---------------- combat ---------------- */
769	function dmgMult(){ return (1 + 0.12 * S.field.filter(u=>u&&UNIT_BY_ID[u.id].base==='MS').length) * (S.focusT>0?1.25:1); }
770	function damageEnemy(e, dmg, opts={}){
771	  if (e.dead) return;
772	  const real = dmg * (1 - e.armor);
773	  e.hp -= real;
774	  if (opts.dot) e.dots.push({ dps:opts.dot, t:opts.dotT||2 });
775	  if (opts.slow){ e.slowT = Math.max(e.slowT, opts.slowT||1.2); e.slowF = Math.max(e.slowF, opts.slow); }
776	  if (opts.stun) e.stunT = Math.max(e.stunT, opts.stun);
777	  if (opts.greed){ S.gold += opts.greed; S.goldEarned += opts.greed; }
778	  const p = pathPos(e.d);
779	  if (opts.crit || real >= 60) float(p.x, p.y-e.r-6, Math.round(real), opts.crit?'#ffc93d':'#f2ead8', opts.crit?15:11);
780	  if (e.hp <= 0){
781	    e.dead = true;
782	    S.kills++; S.gold += e.gold; S.goldEarned += e.gold;
783	    onKillReward(e, p);
784	    burst(p.x, p.y, e.color, e.boss?30:8);
785	    if (e.boss){ S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, 9); ringFx(p.x,p.y,e.color,80); log(`Boss destroyed! +◈${e.gold}`, 'good'); }
786	    AudioFX.kill();
787	    bump($('stGold').parentElement);
788	    syncStats();
789	  } else AudioFX.hit();
790	}
791	function enemiesInRange(x,y,r){
792	  const out=[];
793	  for (const e of S.enemies){
794	    if (e.dead) continue;
795	    const p=pathPos(e.d);
796	    if ((p.x-x)**2+(p.y-y)**2 <= r*r) out.push({e,p});
797	  }
798	  return out;
799	}
800	function unitAttack(u, def, x, y){
801	  const inR = enemiesInRange(x,y,def.range);
802	  if (!inR.length) return false;
803	  inR.sort((a,b)=>b.e.d-a.e.d);
804	  const first = (S.focusT>0 && inR.find(o=>o.e.uid===S.focusUid)) || inR[0];
805	  const mult = dmgMult();
806	  const g = GRADES[def.grade];
807	  AudioFX.shoot();
808	  const fire = (target, dmg, extra={}) => {
809	    S.projectiles.push({ uid:uidSeq++, x, y, t:target.e, tx:target.p.x, ty:target.p.y, sp:460, dmg, color:g.color, def, ...extra });
810	  };
811	  switch (def.kind){
812	    case 'single': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {greed:def.greed}); break;
813	    case 'crit': {
814	      const crit = Math.random() < (def.critC||0.25);
815	      fire(first, def.dmg*mult*(crit?(def.critX||2):1), {crit, greed:def.greed});
816	      break;
817	    }
818	    case 'slow': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {slow:def.slow, slowT:def.slowT, aoe:def.aoe}); break;
819	    case 'stun': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, stunC:def.stunC, stunT:def.stunT}); break;
820	    case 'aoe': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe||40}); break;
821	    case 'burn': case 'poison': fire(first, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe||40, dot:def.dot, dotT:def.dotT}); break;
822	    case 'pierce': {
823	      const targets = [first, ...inR.slice(1).filter(o=>(o.p.x-first.p.x)**2+(o.p.y-first.p.y)**2<95*95).slice(0,(def.pierce||2)-1)];
824	      targets.forEach(t=>fire(t, def.dmg*mult, {aoe:def.aoe, fast:true}));
825	      break;
826	    }
827	    case 'multi': {
828	      const n = def.multi||2;
829	      for (let i=0;i<n;i++) fire(inR[i%inR.length], def.dmg*mult, {dot:def.dot, dotT:def.dotT});
830	      break;
831	    }
832	    case 'chain': {
833	      let cur = first; const hit=new Set(); const pts=[{x,y}];
834	      let dmg = def.dmg*mult;
835	      for (let i=0;i<(def.chain||3);i++){
836	        if (!cur) break;
837	        hit.add(cur.e);
838	        pts.push({x:cur.p.x,y:cur.p.y});
839	        damageEnemy(cur.e, dmg, {});
840	        dmg *= 0.75;
841	        const next = S.enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead&&!hit.has(e)).map(e=>({e,p:pathPos(e.d)}))
842	          .filter(o=>(o.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(o.p.y-cur.p.y)**2<130*130)
843	          .sort((a,b)=>((a.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(a.p.y-cur.p.y)**2)-((b.p.x-cur.p.x)**2+(b.p.y-cur.p.y)**2))[0];
844	        cur = next;
845	      }
846	      S.beams.push({uid:uidSeq++, pts, t:0, life:0.18, color:g.color, w:2.5, lightning:true});
847	      break;
848	    }
849	    case 'beam': {
850	      damageEnemy(first.e, def.dmg*mult, {});
851	      if (def.aoe){
852	        S.enemies.forEach(e=>{
853	          if (e.dead || e===first.e) return;
854	          const p=pathPos(e.d);
855	          if ((p.x-first.p.x)**2+(p.y-first.p.y)**2 < def.aoe*def.aoe) damageEnemy(e, def.dmg*mult*0.7, {});
856	        });
857	        ringFx(first.p.x, first.p.y, g.color, def.aoe);
858	      }
859	      S.beams.push({uid:uidSeq++, pts:[{x,y},{x:first.p.x,y:first.p.y}], t:0, life:0.16, color:g.color, w:def.aoe?5:3});
860	      burst(first.p.x, first.p.y, g.color, 5);
861	      break;
862	    }
863	  }
864	  return true;
865	}
866	function projectileImpact(pr){
867	  const hitOne = (e)=>{
868	    damageEnemy(e, pr.dmg, {
869	      crit:pr.crit, dot:pr.dot, dotT:pr.dotT, slow:pr.slow, slowT:pr.slowT,

898	/* ---------------- update (driven by the 3D loop) ---------------- */
899	function update(dt){
900	  S.time += dt;
901	  if (S.facCd.seal>0) S.facCd.seal=Math.max(0,S.facCd.seal-dt);
902	  if (S.facCd.focus>0) S.facCd.focus=Math.max(0,S.facCd.focus-dt);
903	  if (S.facCd.super>0) S.facCd.super=Math.max(0,S.facCd.super-dt);
904	  for (const g of GOLD_GAMBLES){
905	    const st=S.gambleStocks[g.key];
906	    if (st.n<g.charges){
907	      st.t+=dt;
908	      if (st.t>=g.cd){ st.t-=g.cd; st.n++; }
909	    } else st.t=0;
910	  }
911	  if (S.focusT>0) S.focusT=Math.max(0,S.focusT-dt);
912	  S.facUiT=(S.facUiT||0)+dt;
913	  if (S.facUiT>0.25){ S.facUiT=0; syncFaction(); syncGambling(); }
914	  if (S.waveActive && S.spawnQueue.length){
915	    S.spawnT -= dt;
916	    if (S.spawnT <= 0){
917	      const type = S.spawnQueue.shift();
918	      spawnEnemy(type);
919	      S.spawnT = type==='boss' ? 1.6 : Math.max(0.35, 0.95 - S.wave*0.02);
920	    }
921	  }
922	  if (S.auto && !S.waveActive && S.mode==='play' && S.wave>0 && S.wave<S.diff.waves){
923	    S.autoT -= dt;
924	    if (S.autoT<=0) startWave();
925	  }
926	  for (const e of S.enemies){
927	    if (e.dead) continue;
928	    if (e.slowT>0) e.slowT-=dt;
929	    if (e.stunT>0) e.stunT-=dt;
930	    for (const d of e.dots){ d.t-=dt; if (d.t>0){ e.hp -= d.dps*dt*(1-e.armor); } }
931	    e.dots = e.dots.filter(d=>d.t>0);
932	    if (e.regen) e.hp = Math.min(e.maxHp, e.hp + e.maxHp*e.regen*dt);
933	    if (e.hp<=0){
934	      e.dead=true; S.kills++; S.gold+=e.gold; S.goldEarned+=e.gold;
935	      const p=pathPos(e.d); onKillReward(e,p); burst(p.x,p.y,'#5dc86a',6); AudioFX.kill(); syncStats();
936	      continue;
937	    }
938	    const slow = e.slowT>0 ? 1-e.slowF : 1;
939	    e.d += e.sp * slow * (e.stunT>0?0:1) * dt;
940	    if (e.d >= PATH_LEN){
941	      e.dead = true;
942	      S.lives -= e.leak;
943	      S.leakFlash = 0.5; S.shake = Math.max(S.shake, e.boss?10:5);
944	      AudioFX.leak();
945	      log(`${e.boss?'BOSS':'Enemy'} leaked! −${e.leak} ♥`, 'bad');
946	      bump($('stLives').parentElement);
947	      syncStats();
948	      if (S.lives<=0){ S.lives=0; syncStats(); return gameOver(false); }
949	    }
950	  }
951	  S.enemies = S.enemies.filter(e=>!e.dead);
952	  if (S.waveActive && !S.spawnQueue.length && !S.enemies.length) endWave();
953	  S.field.forEach((u,i)=>{
954	    if (!u) return;
955	    u.cd -= dt;
956	    if (u.cd<=0){
957	      const def = UNIT_BY_ID[u.id];
958	      if (unitAttack(u, def, u.x, u.y)) u.cd = 1/def.rate;
959	      else u.cd = 0.08;
960	    }
961	  });
962	  for (const pr of S.projectiles){
963	    if (pr.t && !pr.t.dead){ const p=pathPos(pr.t.d); pr.tx=p.x; pr.ty=p.y; }
964	    const dx=pr.tx-pr.x, dy=pr.ty-pr.y, dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
965	    const step=(pr.fast?640:pr.sp)*dt;
966	    if (dist<=step+4){ pr.done=true; projectileImpact(pr); }
967	    else { pr.x+=dx/dist*step; pr.y+=dy/dist*step; }
968	  }
969	  S.projectiles = S.projectiles.filter(p=>!p.done);
970	  for (const b of S.beams) b.t+=dt;
971	  S.beams = S.beams.filter(b=>b.t<b.life);
972	  for (const r of S.rings) r.t+=dt;
973	  S.rings = S.rings.filter(r=>r.t<r.life);
974	  for (const p of S.particles){ p.t+=dt; p.x+=p.vx*dt; p.y+=p.vy*dt; p.vx*=0.96; p.vy*=0.96; }
975	  S.particles = S.particles.filter(p=>p.t<p.life);
976	  for (const f of S.floats){ f.t+=dt; f.y-=28*dt; }
977	  S.floats = S.floats.filter(f=>f.t<f.life);
978	  S.shake = Math.max(0, S.shake - dt*22);
979	  S.leakFlash = Math.max(0, S.leakFlash - dt);
980	}

442	for (let i=0;i<PATH.length-1;i++){
443	  const [x1,y1]=PATH[i],[x2,y2]=PATH[i+1];
444	  const len=Math.hypot(x2-x1,y2-y1);

447	function pathPos(d){
448	  d=Math.max(0,Math.min(PATH_LEN,d));
449	  for (const s of PATH_SEG){ if (d<=s.start+s.len){ const t=(d-s.start)/s.len;
450	    return {x:s.x1+(s.x2-s.x1)*t, y:s.y1+(s.y2-s.y1)*t}; } }
451	  const s=PATH_SEG[PATH_SEG.length-1]; return {x:s.x2,y:s.y2};
452	}

462	function placementReason(x, y, field=[], ignoreUid=null){
463	  if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y) || x<PLACEMENT.minX || x>PLACEMENT.maxX || y<PLACEMENT.minY || y>PLACEMENT.maxY) return 'bounds';
464	  const clearance = CFG.ring.w/2 + PLACEMENT.roadPadding;
465	  if (Math.abs(y-CFG.H/2)<=clearance && (x<CFG.ring.l || x>CFG.ring.r)) return 'gate';
466	  for (const s of PATH_SEG){
467	    const dx=s.x2-s.x1, dy=s.y2-s.y1;
468	    const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((x-s.x1)*dx+(y-s.y1)*dy)/(s.len*s.len)));
469	    if (Math.hypot(x-(s.x1+dx*t), y-(s.y1+dy*t))<=clearance) return 'road';
470	  }
471	  for (const u of field){
472	    if (!u || u.uid===ignoreUid) continue;
473	    if (Math.hypot(x-u.x,y-u.y)<PLACEMENT.unitGap) return 'too-close';
474	  }
475	  return '';
476	}

479	function shade(hex,f){
480	  const n=parseInt(hex.slice(1),16);
481	  let r=(n>>16)&255,g=(n>>8)&255,b=n&255;
482	  r=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(r*f)));
483	  g=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(g*f)));
484	  b=Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(b*f)));
485	  return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
486	}
